raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides senior level consultant level support for Molina’s quality performance solutions team. Collaborates with various departments and stakeholders across the enterprise to plan, coordinate, and manage resources, and execute quality performance improvement initiatives in alignment with strategic objectives.

Essential Job Duties

  • Collaborates with health plan quality leaders to improve outcomes by leading quality data collection strategy, analytics, and reporting for the following: quality rate trending and forecasting, provider quality measurement performance, Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) and survey analytics, health equity and social determinants of health (SDOH), and external vendor engagement.
  • Ensures quality programs are successfully delivered on time, within scope, and within resource constraints.
  • Oversees quality data ingestion activities and strategies to optimize completeness and accuracy of electronic health record (EHR)/health information exchange (HIE) and supplemental data impact.
  • Independently identifies, analyzes, and resolves complex quality issues using data analysis, project management skills, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Leads execution of complex quality assignments, supports program changes, ensures alignment with program goals, and updates leadership and applicable parties on program/project development.
  • Draws actionable quality-related conclusions and recommends performance improvement initiatives.
  • Ensures compliance with all quality-related regulatory audit guidelines by adhering to roadmap of deliverables and timelines, and implements solutions to maximize national Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) audit success.
  • Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure data quality delivery through sequential transformations, draws actionable conclusions, and identifies opportunities to close quality care gaps.
  • Ensures that program deliverables meet all quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Creates and reviews quality-related program documentation, including plans, reports, and records, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively communicates risks, issues, and progress to stakeholders and escalates unresolved or high-impact concerns to leadership as appropriate.
  • Meets customer expectations and requirements, establishes, and maintains effective relationships and gains trust and respect.
  • Provides advanced subject matter support within the quality team; maintains flexibility to pivot and support other requests as needed.
  • Provides informal guidance and knowledge sharing to team members related to assigned quality initiatives and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of program/project management experience in quality, including experience supporting HEDIS activities targeting and reporting, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Health care experience and functional quality knowledge.
  • Familiarity with running queries in Microsoft Azure or Structured Query Language (SQL) server.
  • Intellectual agility and ability to simplify and clearly communicate complex concepts.
  • Proficiency with data analysis, manipulation, interpretation, and reporting.
  • Strong quantitative aptitude, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work cross-collaboratively in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office suite (including Excel) and applicable software programs proficiency, and ability to learn/navigate new software programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Intermediate knowledge/experience related to National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), Healthcare Effectiveness Data Information Set (HEDIS), Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and state-specific regulatory submission requirements.
  • Microsoft Azure Databricks and SQL proficiency.
  • Knowledge of health care claim elements: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT), CPT Category II (CPTII), Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC), Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine – Clinical Terms (SNOMED), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPS), National Drug Code (NDC), CVX Codes (CVX), National Provider Identifiers (NPIs), Taxpayer Identification Numbers (TINs), etc.
  • Experience working in a cross-functional, highly matrixed organization, preferably within a managed care organization supporting Medicaid, Medicare, and/or Marketplace programs.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, and/or comparable coursework.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

About the Role

Own the compliance program for a fintech company supporting cross-border payments and digital-asset services. You will lead day-to-day operations and key risk decisions, helping the business serve clients and expand into new markets while managing risk responsibly.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the designated BSA/AML Officer and own compliance policies, procedures, and the risk model.

  • Make and document final decisions on escalated onboarding, wallet-screening, and transaction-monitoring cases, including SAR decisions.

  • Lead and mentor compliance analysts, and take ownership of their escalations.

  • Work with the business to develop risk-based controls for complex clients and markets.

  • Represent the compliance program in bank and payment-partner due diligence, requests for information, and audits.

  • Oversee compliance workflows and tools, including AI-assisted processes used by analysts.

What We're Looking For

  • Three to twelve years of relevant experience, including leadership of a compliance team and ownership of a full compliance program at a fintech, payments, or crypto company.

  • Experience across compliance and crypto in the Americas, including US-Latin America cross-border trade and trade-based money-laundering risks.

  • Practical experience developing BSA/AML policies and risk models, handling SAR filings and regulatory reporting, and managing KYC/KYB onboarding, wallet screening, and transaction monitoring.

  • Knowledge of stablecoins, digital-asset compliance standards, and crypto exchange controls.

  • Experience using Elliptic or Chainalysis for investigations or wallet screening, and coordinating audits and due diligence with banks or payment partners.

  • Ability to make documented, risk-based decisions and identify appropriate controls for higher-risk cases and markets.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $120,000 to $160,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote in the United States or Latin America.

Compensation Range: $120K - $160K

raw.description:
Solution Architect

Who We Need

ADA is looking for an experienced Solution Architect who can operate as a trusted technical authority across the business. This is a company-level role: rather than being fully embedded in one project or customer, the Solution Architect will consult across multiple projects, clients and strategic initiatives while remaining close enough to delivery to guide implementation and quality.

At this stage of your career, you are expected to have demonstrated that you:

  • Can be fully trusted with technical decision-making and architectural direction.
  • Can balance technical requirements, delivery constraints and a project’s business objectives.
  • Contribute to improving ADA’s technical landscape, engineering practices and reusable capability.
  • Actively build your own professional brand and the Decision Inc. brand internally and within the broader technology community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Consulting: Provide architecture leadership across multiple engagements; translate business needs into scalable, secure and maintainable solutions; assess existing systems; define target architectures and make pragmatic technology decisions.
  • Implementation: Remain hands-on enough to validate architecture through delivery, support critical implementation decisions and guide teams through complex technical challenges.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, provide technical escalation support and raise engineering capability across teams.
  • Standards & Quality: Act as a custodian of delivery quality by defining and governing architecture standards, technical documentation, design decisions and engineering quality gates.
  • Evaluate architectural trade-offs and recommend technologies based on business requirements rather than technology preference.
  • Produce and maintain solution architecture documentation, technical diagrams and architecture decisions.
  • Presales: Shape solution approaches during proposals and client engagements, validate feasibility, identify technical risks and support estimation and solution positioning.
  • Community & Brand: Contribute to thought leadership, technical communities, internal forums and external industry engagement to strengthen the Decision Inc. technical brand.
  • Training & Capability Development: Help define technical learning priorities, contribute to training content and support the development of architects, Technical Leads and engineers.
  • Research & Development: Allocate time to emerging technologies, architectural patterns and practical experimentation that can improve client solutions and internal capability.

Technical Scope

  • The role is technology-agnostic and requires broad architectural depth across modern custom development and digital solutions. Key areas include:
  • Custom development: Java, .NET/C#, React, Angular and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Architecture: enterprise applications, microservices, modular and event-driven architectures, APIs, integration patterns, distributed systems and security-by-design.
  • Cloud & infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, containers, networking, identity, scalability, resilience, monitoring and observability; AWS exposure is advantageous.
  • Data & integration: SQL, relational databases, data modelling, REST APIs, synchronous/asynchronous integration and application data architecture.
  • DevOps & engineering quality: CI/CD, source control, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, deployment strategies and technical quality gates.
  • Emerging technologies: AI-enabled applications, AI service integration, low-code platforms and application modernisation.

How you work

  • Make technology choices based on business problems, not platform preference.
  • Evaluate trade-offs across cost, speed, scalability, security, maintainability and operational complexity.
  • Communicate architecture clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Provide direction without becoming a bottleneck, enabling teams to make sound decisions independently.

Experience and Capability

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Typically 7–10+ years’ experience across software engineering, technical leadership and solution architecture.
  • Strong foundation in custom application development and modern enterprise architecture.
  • Experience designing solutions across frontend, backend, integration, data, cloud and infrastructure concerns.
  • Strong Azure architecture experience; AWS exposure advantageous.
  • Experience providing technical governance, reviewing designs and guiding multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Strong consulting and stakeholder engagement capability, including the ability to operate across several clients and initiatives.
  • Experience supporting presales, technical assessments, estimation or solution shaping is advantageous.

What success looks like

  • Projects make sound, consistent technical decisions with fewer late-stage architecture issues.
  • Technical Leads and engineering teams become stronger and more self-sufficient through effective mentorship.
  • Reusable standards, patterns and lessons are shared across ADA rather than remaining within individual projects.
  • Presales solutions are technically credible, commercially pragmatic and aligned to client outcomes.
  • Decision Inc. strengthens its reputation for high-quality engineering, architecture and modern digital solution delivery.

raw.description:
Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

We are seeking a passionate Pediatrician to join our multi-disciplinary clinical team as an Obesity Specialist. In this role, you will be at the forefront of our new program, providing virtual care centered around family-based behavioral therapy and individualized medical management for children and teens (ages 5-17).

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

What makes this role unique:

  • Integrated Care Model: Work within a multi-disciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, Master’s level therapists and psychologists to provide integrated, evidence-based care.

  • Pioneer a New Program: Contribute directly to the development and iteration of our Obesity and Overweight care model, workflows, and clinical tools.

  • Professional Growth: We encourage clinicians to develop special areas of expertise and become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training, guidance from experts, and stipends for professional development.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct 60-minute virtual intake appointments to screen for obesity/overweight and determine individualized treatment plans.

  • Provide comprehensive clinical services, including medication management (e.g., GLP-1s and other anti-obesity medications) and ordering/interpreting diagnostic labs.

  • Lead our "Positive Parenting for Healthy Weight" Shared Medical Appointment groups

  • Collaborate with behavioral health colleagues and refer to other services as appropriate

  • Lead 30-minute medical follow-up appointments to monitor progress and adjust treatment plans.

  • Complete clinical documentation and administrative work accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Collaborate with nursing staff on prior authorizations and care coordination.

Qualifications:

  • Licensure: Licensed to practice medicine in California with active DEA registration

  • Board Certification: Board certified by the American Board of Pediatrics. Board certification in Obesity Medicine preferred.

  • Experience: At least 5 years of patient care experience.

  • Specialized Interest: Deep interest or experience in Lifestyle Medicine, nutrition coaching, and physical activity.

  • Tech-Savvy: Confidence in using electronic medical records (EMR) and telemedicine tools to deliver virtual care.

  • Cultural Responsiveness: Experience working with families from diverse backgrounds and a commitment to providing culturally responsive treatment.

  • Startup Mindset: Excitement about joining a fast-growing startup and iterating on new care models.

Nice to have:

  • Spanish-speaking (to support our upcoming Spanish-language initiatives).

  • Licensed in additional states (or open to obtaining additional licenses with our support).

Job Type: Full-time (30+ hours)

Location: Remote

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Pay: The target salary for this role will be $220,000-$245,000/year (full-time)

  • Competitive salary with medical and ancillary benefits, including 401(K)

  • Remote-friendly culture

  • Flexible time off

Schedule:

  • Monday through Friday (Pacific) 8am - 8pm PT

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Director to lead the administration and user enablement of Peraton[x], our enterprise generative AI and agentic analytics platform. This leader is accountable for how the platform is configured, governed, and accessed, and for making sure every program that uses it can do so successfully. The Director leads a multidisciplinary team of system administrators, AI analysts, business analysts, and knowledge workers who onboard users, build reusable solutions, curate knowledge, and drive adoption across Peraton. The role connects end users, program leadership, and platform engineering. It turns business needs into well-administered platform capabilities and measurable adoption outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Governance

  • Lead all Peraton[x] system administration, including user and program provisioning, role-based access and data-tier management, environment configuration, and platform settings.
  • Set and enforce administrative standards, policies, and procedures for access requests, onboarding and offboarding, project and workspace management, and knowledge-base (cortex) governance.
  • Oversee release readiness and change management from the administrator and end-user side, including communicating platform changes, new features, and impacts to users.
  • Run the service desk and tiered user support model: ticket intake, triage, escalation to engineering, and resolution tracking against service-level targets.
  • Manage AI usage, cost, and license administration: track consumption and spend by program, attribute costs, and enforce usage policies.
  • Maintain administrative documentation, runbooks, and audit-ready records of access, configuration, and change.

User Enablement & Adoption

  • Own the Peraton[x] enablement strategy, including role-based onboarding, training curricula, office hours, user guides, and playbooks for new and experienced users.
  • Build and lead a community of practice and a power-user/champion network across programs to spread best practices and grow adoption.
  • Direct AI and business analysts in designing reusable skills, flows, workflows, dashboards, and templates that solve recurring program problems and lower the barrier to entry.
  • Partner with programs to identify high-value use cases, guide pilots, and scale successful solutions across the enterprise.
  • Measure adoption, engagement, and value using usage analytics and user feedback, and use the results to target training and improvements.

Knowledge Management

  • Lead knowledge workers in curating, organizing, and governing platform content, including enrolled documents, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and reference materials.
  • Set standards for content quality, metadata, classification, and lifecycle (review, archive, retire) so knowledge stays accurate and discoverable.
  • Maintain a central knowledge base of FAQs, how-to content, and lessons learned for users and administrators.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of system administrators, AI analysts, business analysts, and knowledge workers.
  • Define roles, career paths, performance goals, and development plans, including AI literacy, prompt and agent design, and platform administration skills.
  • Plan staffing and hiring, and assign team members to programs based on enablement and support demand.
  • Build a culture of service, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for program leaders and business units on platform access, onboarding, support, and adoption.
  • Gather and prioritize user and program requirements and represent them to product and engineering teams.
  • Report adoption, user satisfaction, support performance, cost, and value metrics to senior leadership.
  • Manage the administration and enablement budget, vendor relationships, and licensing.

Security, Compliance & Responsible AI

  • Make sure platform administration complies with Peraton policy, the Acceptable Use Policy, and relevant frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-171, CMMC, FedRAMP).
  • Enforce least-privilege access, data classification, periodic access reviews, and audit-evidence practices.
  • Promote responsible AI use through training, human-in-the-loop review, output verification, and governed approval workflows.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • 16+ years of experience in system or platform administration, IT service management, technology enablement, or analytics delivery, including 5+ years leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proven experience administering enterprise SaaS, collaboration, or analytics platforms, including user and access management, configuration, and governance.
  • Demonstrated success leading technology adoption, training, and change-management programs across large or distributed organizations.
  • Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic workflows, and how they create business and mission value.
  • Experience running service desk and user support operations (ITIL or equivalent).
  • Experience leading mixed technical and non-technical teams (e.g., administrators, analysts, knowledge managers).
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to train users, brief executives, and turn technical topics into business terms.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors, and licensing.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, if required by the program.
  • U.S. Citizenship Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with knowledge management, content governance, ontologies, or knowledge graphs.
  • Background in instructional design, training development, or a customer success or enablement role.
  • Background in data analytics, business analysis, or all-source analysis.
  • Experience administering systems in regulated or DoD environments (NIST 800-171, CMMC, FedRAMP, ATO).
  • Certifications such as ITIL, Prosci/change management, PMP, AWS, or Agile/SAFe.
  • Experience with AI usage and cost governance (FinOps) and platform analytics.

Target Salary Range

$146,000 - $234,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

raw.description:
You could lead a team anywhere. Why us?

  • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 60X revenue growth in 5 years | $2T market size).

  • Work with a high-caliber team from companies like Lemonade, GEICO, Bain & Co, and McKinsey.

  • Disrupt a massive market and help us scale to a $10B business in the next few years.

  • Be immersed in a talent-dense environment that prioritizes first-principles thinking and rapid career acceleration.

About the Opportunity:

Jerry is growing fast, and more than 5 million customers count on us to make car insurance simple. As Team Lead on our Insurance Service team, you’ll work closely with the Manager, Contact Center Operations, to coach a team of 10 insurance agents and make sure every customer gets a white-glove experience.

Behind every great customer experience at Jerry is a team of licensed agents, ready on calls, chats, and digital channels. As their leader, you’ll raise that team’s game: coaching every agent to their best, setting a high bar for service, keeping the team compliant, and solving problems before customers ever notice them.

How You Will Make an Impact:

  • Coaching & Performance: Lift team results through regular 1:1s, clear feedback, and performance reviews, and catch performance issues early.

  • Operations & Compliance: Own staffing and coverage, quality reviews, timesheets, and PTO, and keep every agent compliant with insurance regulations and Jerry policy.

  • Escalations: Resolve complex product, carrier, and system issues, and step in on customer calls when needed.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Work across the business to fix operational problems at the source and help shape the initiatives that scale Jerry’s customer experience.

Who You Are:

  • A People Leader: You drive results by coaching consistently, not just when something goes wrong.

  • An Insurance & Systems Expert: You know policies, regulations, and call center and CRM tools well enough to answer tough questions and troubleshoot complex issues.

  • Customer-Obsessed: You hold a high bar for service, sweat the details, and fix issues fast.

  • Truth-Seeking: You bring rigor to every part of the job, from your own work to your team’s. Resolving a customer’s issue is just the start; you aim to leave an impression that keeps them coming back.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Pay: $50,000 - $60,000 annual base

  • Workplace: Remote (we will provide you with equipment)

  • Benefits: Insurance (health, vision, dental), paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K with employer matching, etc.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in a high-volume contact center in the insurance or financial services industry.

  • Demonstrated experience in a leadership or "player-coach" capacity (Team Lead, Senior Rep, or Manager).

  • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license is required (or willingness to obtain one quickly).

  • Strong technical aptitude and comfort with CRM tools and omni-channel communication platforms.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Your role at Vantive
The Associate Director, Product Management will lead the strategy, modernization, and ongoing evolution of the customer portal as a scalable digital product.


This role is accountable for defining the product vision and roadmap, translating customer and business needs into prioritized outcomes, and guiding a cross-functional product team from discovery through delivery, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. The role serves as the voice of the customer and connects Digital Product Management, Engineering, UX, Commercial, Customer Success, Operations, Legal, Privacy, Security, Quality, and other partners to create a coherent, secure, and intuitive portal experience.


What you’ll be doing


Product Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Define and communicate the customer portal product vision, modernization strategy, value proposition, and multi-horizon roadmap in alignment with customer needs, enterprise priorities, and platform direction.
  • Own product outcomes and lifecycle priorities across discovery, modernization, migration, launch, adoption, optimization, and sustainment.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify customer journeys, improve self-service, reduce friction, and create a consistent experience across portal capabilities and touchpoints.
  • Develop business cases, value hypotheses, financial assumptions, and decision frameworks that support investment, sequencing, capacity, and long-range planning.
  • Maintain a clear view of scope boundaries, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and decisions, ensuring stakeholders understand what is being prioritized and why.

Customer Experience and Discovery

  • Serve as the voice of the customer, grounding decisions in customer research, journey insights, usage data, service feedback, market needs, and operational realities.
  • Lead discovery with UX, research, analytics, Commercial, Customer Success, and regional partners to define problem statements, target users, desired outcomes, and measurable success criteria.
  • Champion an accessible, intuitive, and consistent portal experience, with appropriate consideration for localization, market variation, and diverse customer workflows.
  • Validate product concepts and assumptions with customers and internal users before significant investment, and incorporate learning into roadmap and release decisions.
  • Ensure modernization efforts address both the visible customer experience and the underlying process, content, data, and support model required to sustain it.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead and guide the core product team across the customer portal value stream, partnering closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Lead, UX, Architecture, PMO, and functional stakeholders.
  • Own the “what” and “why” for the product, while partnering with the Product Owner and technical team on solution shaping, decomposition, sequencing, and execution feasibility.
  • Author and sponsor epics, and ensure epics and features are ready enough for planning with a clear problem statement, intended outcome, scope, value, dependencies, and business acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in product and agile operating rhythms, including discovery, backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, program increment planning, and daily ceremonies as needed.
  • Make timely priority and trade-off decisions, remove ambiguity, help unblock progress, and provide one coherent direction to the delivery team.
  • Coordinate across adjacent products, shared platforms, content owners, identity and access services, data teams, and enterprise systems to manage dependencies and avoid fragmented customer experiences.

Modernization, Migration, and Operational Readiness

  • Define the phased modernization and migration approach, balancing customer value, technical risk, regulatory obligations, operational continuity, and speed to learning.
  • Partner with technical leaders to shape platform capabilities that are scalable, maintainable, observable, and reusable across markets and customer segments.
  • Lead cross-functional readiness for releases, including customer communications, support processes, training, content readiness, service transition, and escalation pathways.
  • Ensure legacy experiences and capabilities are rationalized deliberately, with clear criteria for migration, coexistence, decommissioning, and customer transition.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, Quality, Regulatory, and data governance stakeholders early and throughout the lifecycle to embed required controls and evidence into product decisions and delivery.
  • Establish governance mechanisms that support rapid decisions while maintaining traceability, risk management, and accountability in a regulated environment.


Adoption, Measurement, and Continuous Improvement

  • Define a product KPI framework that connects customer experience, adoption, operational performance, reliability, and business value.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate product performance, identify friction and unmet needs, and recommend roadmap adjustments.
  • Partner with Analytics, Customer Success, Commercial, and Operations to create transparent reporting and dashboards for product, leadership, and regional stakeholders.
  • Lead post-launch reviews and continuous improvement, ensuring customer feedback, support trends, product analytics, and retrospective learning translate into prioritized action.
  • Promote disciplined product experimentation and outcome-based decision-making, distinguishing activity and feature delivery from measurable customer and business impact.

Stakeholder Leadership and Communication

  • Build alignment across senior leaders, regions, functions, and delivery teams around product direction, priorities, investment needs, and critical trade-offs.
  • Translate complex customer, business, regulatory, and technical considerations into clear recommendations for executive and cross-functional audiences.
  • Create an effective stakeholder engagement model for customer and regional input, roadmap communication, decision-making, and escalation.
  • Represent the customer portal product internally and, as appropriate, in customer advisory, research, and co-creation settings.
  • Mentor product team members and model strong product management practices, including customer-centered discovery, economic prioritization, outcome measurement, and continuous refinement.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree such as an MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, product strategy, customer experience, digital platforms, software, or related areas.
  • 5+ years of experience leading change management and large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, discovery, prioritization, and translating business needs into executable product plans.
  • Demonstrated experience modernizing customer-facing digital platforms, including migration, adoption, phased implementation, and legacy transition.
  • Strong experience working across Product, Engineering, UX, Architecture, Data, and program leadership in agile/product operating models.
  • Strong analytical, executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills within complex global organizations.
  • Experience in healthcare, MedTech, digital health, life sciences, or another regulated industry strongly preferred.
  • Experience with CRM, customer portals, identity/access, personalization, commerce/ordering, analytics, content management, and enterprise integrations is a plus.
  • Open to applicants across the country, this is a remote position

  • Strong track record hiring high-quality engineers through direct sourcing and headhunting.

  • Deep familiarity with technical talent markets and strong understanding of software engineering and AI/ML profiles.

  • Ability to distinguish exceptional technical work from strong branding, titles or CV keywords.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior engineering leaders on hiring strategy and calibration.

  • Strong judgement, urgency and willingness to remain deeply hands-on.

Nice to Have

  • Existing networks across AI/ML and engineering communities.

Jerry is the #1 rated app for car owners. We help over 5 million people save money on insurance, repairs, and loans—all in one place. Since 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the U.S.

We are looking for an Insurance Compliance & Regulatory Senior Lead to join our Insurance Operations team. Reporting directly to our Senior Manager of Insurance Ops, this role is ideal for an experienced insurance operations leader who excels at solving complex systemic issues, building rigorous compliance frameworks, and acting as the strategic bridge between our customers, carrier partners, state regulators, and internal product teams.

This role may be a fit for you if:

  • You write with judgment, not just accuracy. You can take a complicated file, determine what actually happened, and state a clear, complete, well-supported position under a deadline.

  • You solve problems at the root. You love digging beneath the surface to identify root causes and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves to resolve complex edge cases while mentoring others to do the same.

  • You excel at high-stakes de-escalation. You possess executive-level composure and genuine empathy, easily navigating intense situations with customers, state regulators, and insurance carrier leaders.

  • You turn friction into product fixes. You naturally spot patterns in complaint data and have the strategic mindset to partner with tech, legal, and ops leaders to permanently fix underlying vulnerabilities.

  • You build and maintain operational rigor. You thrive in a remote environment, bringing organization, accountability, and process design to ensure compliance deadlines are met without exception.

What you’ll actually do:

  • Lead Escalation Operations: Oversee the end-to-end investigation and de-escalation framework for critical customer complaints, acting as the final point of escalation for complex issues.

  • Own DOI and Insurance Carrier Responses: Manage carrier audits and state regulatory complaint workflows; author, review, and finalize official correspondence to state departments of insurance, carrier partners, and consumers.

  • Systemic Root-Cause Resolution: Partner with Legal, Product, and Engineering to convert audit findings and complaint trends into product changes, automated checks, and process fixes.

  • Complaint Log & Compliance Controls: Own the complaint log and the workflows behind it, keeping records accurate and audit-ready for market conduct examinations and state data calls, and meeting statutory deadlines and internal SLAs.

  • Carrier Relationship & Claims Support: Serve as the primary operational liaison for carrier partners during high-stakes claims investigations, regulatory inquiries, and information audits.

  • Team Guidance & Coaching: Provide operational guidance, quality oversight, and subject-matter expertise to team members handling customer service, compliance, and claims support.

  • Exceptional executive-level written and verbal communication skills with an eye for legal and compliance detail.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive cross-functional product and operational improvements.

  • Apresentar soluções técnicas e comerciais alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Participar de feiras, eventos do setor e fóruns técnicos relevantes para os mercados-alvo.
  • Identificar e desenvolver novos canais de distribuição, representantes comerciais e parcerias estratégicas de negócios.
  • Gerenciar o pipeline de oportunidades de vendas, com foco em conversão e crescimento sustentável.
  • Manter registros precisos e atualizados no CRM, incluindo inteligência de mercado estratégica, informações de clientes e atividades da concorrência.

  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) relacionados ao desenvolvimento de mercado, incluindo aquisição de novos clientes, oportunidades geradas e taxas de conversão.

  • Preparar relatórios de incentivos de vendas e comissões.
  • Gerenciar empréstimos de produtos e equipamentos de demonstração.
  • Solicitar análises de crédito de clientes.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão do pipeline de vendas.
  • Prospectar clientes potenciais e agendar visitas comerciais.
  • Negociar pedidos de compra e cronogramas de entrega.
  • Impulsionar o crescimento das vendas e maximizar oportunidades de receita.
  • Analisar concorrentes, identificando seus pontos fortes e fracos.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-oriented Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team as the operational backbone of our Partner Experience (PX) organization — Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops. In this key role, you will own the systems, workflows, and analytics that power PX — including administration of Planhat and Zendesk — while keeping the post-sale motion tightly aligned with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

As a trusted partner to leadership, you will provide actionable insights that align operations with company goals, helping to accelerate growth and optimize the partner journey — from implementation through expansion and renewal.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the PX Tech Stack: Serve as administrator and product owner for Planhat and Zendesk — health scoring, playbooks, workflows, triggers, SLAs, routing, Salesforce integrations, and reporting. Assist with administration of our LMS/CMS platforms supporting partner education and enablement. Continuously improve these systems so PX teams maintain optimal performance.

  • Optimize Operational Workflows: Design, refine, QA, and implement workflows and processes that enable PX teams to operate at peak efficiency. Streamline operations to ensure seamless handoffs across the full partner lifecycle — from deal close through implementation, clinical adoption, support, and renewal.

  • Empower Data-Driven Insights and Strategic Decisions: Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide leadership with real-time visibility into key metrics, including partner health, adoption and utilization, support volume and SLA attainment, and retention trends. Use data to drive actionable strategies that improve decision making and operational performance.

  • Enhance Revenue & Forecast Clarity: Partner with Finance to support renewal and retention forecasting, analyze commission reports, and generate revenue-related insights that align with business goals and drive clarity across the organization.

  • Business Partner to PX Leadership: Act as the dedicated operations partner to leaders across Partner Success, Clinical Success, Implementation, Support, and PX Ops — translating their priorities into systems, process, and reporting, and representing PX needs in cross-functional RevOps planning with Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar role in a SaaS company (healthcare experience is a plus).

  • Extensive experience with SaaS tools such as Salesforce, Planhat (or Gainsight/similar CS platform), Zendesk, and exposure to LMS/CMS administration. Administration experience with a CS platform or support platform strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of go-to-market strategies and key metrics that influence success in Sales, Marketing, and Partner Success.

  • Direct experience business-partnering with post-sale leadership — Customer/Partner Success, Clinical or Implementation teams, or Support — you understand how these functions operate and what they need from operations.

  • Fluency in post-sale metrics: net revenue retention, gross retention, adoption and utilization, NPS, CSAT, and support SLA performance.

  • Exceptional AI and Business Intelligence experience (Claude, OpenAI, Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, Business Intelligence tools, etc.), with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable operational plans.

  • Proven track record in building and maintaining commercial dashboards and reports that provide clarity and support data-driven decision-making.

  • Demonstrated ability to align cross-functional teams around shared goals, priorities, and revenue-driving strategies.

  • Excellent project management skills, with a history of successfully leading and driving complex initiatives to completion.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across teams.

  • A proactive, problem-solving mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational scalability.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $143,650 - $194,040

raw.description:
Immediate Openings | Ramping Up for the Holiday Season & 2027 Expansion

Position Overview

Seasoned Recruitment is currently partnering with premier mental health organizations to recruit fully licensed Psychotherapists for 100% remote 1099 contractor positions. Our clinical partners are rapidly expanding to meet increased patient demand as they ramp up support for the upcoming holiday season and prepare for continuous growth into 2027.

This role offers complete autonomy over your practice schedule, reliable weekly compensation, and zero marketing overhead.

Key Benefits & Role Highlights

  • 100% Remote & Flexible Scheduling: Enjoy total control over your availability across all 7 days of the week, with client appointments available until 9:00 PM in the client's local time zone.
  • Clients Provided For You: Focus entirely on clinical care without advertising or marketing expenses; all client referrals are assigned directly to your calendar.
  • Fast-Track Onboarding: Start seeing clients quickly with no lengthy credentialing process (under 30 days wait time).
  • Weekly Compensation: Benefit from predictable weekly payouts and employer-provided medical malpractice insurance.
  • Modern Clinical Workflow: Utilize an integrated EMR platform featuring AI-assisted documentation tools and real-time translation capabilities to simplify administrative tasks.

Candidate Requirements

  • Licensure: Must hold a full, active, and unrestricted clinical license allowing independent practice (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LPCC, PsyD, PhD) in at least one U.S. state.
  • Independent Practice: Must be eligible to practice without clinical supervision (associate-level or supervised licenses cannot be considered).
  • Clinical Expertise: Demonstrated competence in delivering evidence-based psychotherapy, managing diagnostic evaluations, and completing defensible clinical documentation.
  • Technical Readiness: High-speed internet connection, secure HIPAA-compliant home office environment, and familiarity with telehealth platforms.

Next Steps

Interested?

If you are prepared to scale your caseload with full schedule autonomy during this period of heightened holiday volume and upcoming 2027 growth, consider the following application pathways:

  • Direct Application: Apply directly to this job posting.
  • Email Submission: Send your updated CV, active state licensure details, and interview availability directly to .
  • Direct Scheduling: Reserve a time slot for an initial phone screening with our talent acquisition team via our Calendly Scheduling Page.

raw.description:
About the Hiring Group

RTI Health Solutions (RTI-HS), a wholly owned subsidiary of RTI International, is an independent and internationally recognized research organization. With offices in the US, UK, Spain, France, and Sweden, we provide healthcare consulting and research expertise to optimize decision making for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device products across the development and marketing lifecycle. Clients rely on our expertise, quality standards, and integrity to guide their product development and regulatory and market access strategies. Our various practice areas include Value, Access, and HEOR; Patient-Centered and Outcomes Research; Epidemiology and Biostatistics; Medical Communications; Global Business Operations; and Strategic Consulting and Growth.

The Director, IT Business Systems Analyst is responsible for leading a team of business systems analysts to align IT initiatives with business objectives. This role involves overseeing the analysis, design, and implementation of business systems, ensuring that solutions meet the organization’s needs.

The Director will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, operations, and business units, to drive process improvements and technology enhancements that support strategic goals.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of business systems analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for business systems analysis, aligning with the organization's overall IT strategy and business goals.
  • Partner with senior leadership to identify and prioritize IT projects that enhance business operations and drive growth.

Business Systems Analysis and Delivery

  • Oversee the analysis of business processes, identifying opportunities for technology solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Ensure the successful design, development, and implementation of business systems, which may include ERP, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
  • Lead the requirements gathering process, ensuring that business needs are accurately captured and translated into functional specifications.
  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Collaborate with project managers to allocate resources effectively and manage project risks and issues.
  • Ensure that all project deliverables meet quality standards and align with business objectives.
  • Serve as a key liaison between IT and business units, ensuring effective communication and alignment of expectations.

Systems Optimization and Governance

  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of business systems, identifying opportunities for optimization and enhancement.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, recommending innovative solutions to improve business operations.
  • Implement best practices in business systems analysis, project management, and IT governance.

Enterprise Integrations and Administration

  • Own the full lifecycle of enterprise integrations—inbound and outbound from the RTI Health Solutions side—for the ERP and CRM systems, including integrations between Deltek Vision/Vantagepoint and Oracle, and Deltek Vision/Vantagepoint and Salesforce.
    • Oversee architecture, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
    • Support integration areas including, but not limited to, currency exchanges; HR, including payroll, timecards, and hours worked; and financials, including basic finance information, procurement, and supply chain.
    • Use integration platform as a service (iPaaS) vendors, which may include Oracle Integration Cloud, Workato, and similar platforms.
  • Govern integration development standards across adapters (REST, SOAP, FTP, DB), scheduled orchestrations, event-driven flows, and error handling patterns.
  • Lead the team's adoption of Agentic AI capabilities within the ERP and CRM systems, including intelligent process automation, AI-assisted orchestration, and enterprise agent frameworks.
  • Define and enforce ERP and CRM best practices for retry logic, fault management, performance, and monitoring.
  • Serve as primary administrator for Deltek Vision/Vantagepoint and Salesforce for RTI Health Solutions.

What You'll Need

  • Master’s degree and 14 years of directly related experience
  • Proven experience leading large-scale IT projects and managing cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to align technology solutions with business needs.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in business analysis methodologies, project management frameworks, and enterprise application platforms.
  • Knowledge of IT governance, risk management, and compliance standards.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to listen and communicate well both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.


Equal Pay Act Minimum/Range

$175,000.00-$190,000.00

raw.description:
Overview

D365 Functional Consultant (Operations & Supply Chain)

Location: US based, remote, with business travels within US manufacturing sites

Duration: 12 months contract

Role Overview

Morgan Advanced Materials is seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant – Operations & Supply Chain to join the Highlander programme delivery team. The role is hands-on and delivery focused, supporting manufacturing sites across Mexico and the USA. The consultant will operate as a core team member within the Operations & Supply Chain functional team.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, optimize, and provide ongoing support for Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) modules across Operations and Supply Chain within a manufacturing environment.
  • Deliver functional support across core SCM areas, including Production Control, Inventory Management, Procurement & Sourcing, Master Planning, Warehousing, and Advanced WMS.
  • Create high‑quality functional documentation, including Functional Design Documents (FDDs), configuration guides, test scripts, and process notes.
  • Support all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including system testing, UAT, training activities, cutover planning, go‑live execution, and post‑go‑live hypercare.
  • Collaborate closely with Global Process Owners, site subject‑matter experts (SMEs), data teams, and technical development teams to ensure end‑to‑end solution alignment.
  • Provide both on-site and remote support to manufacturing locations, ensuring smooth operational continuity and resolving D365-related issues promptly.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Proven experience working as a D365 F&O Functional Consultant within Operations and Supply Chain.
  • Strong background in manufacturing environments, either process manufacturing, discrete manufacturing, or both.
  • Hands‑on involvement in at least one full D365 F&O implementation lifecycle, from design through to go‑live and hypercare.
  • Solid functional understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain and manufacturing processes, including production, inventory, procurement, planning, and warehousing.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into functional designs, configurations, and process documentation
  • Experience supporting or collaborating with manufacturing sites in Mexico and/or the USA.
  • In‑depth knowledge of Advanced Warehouse Management (Advanced WMS) in D365 F&O.
  • Previous experience working alongside or coordinating with System Integrators (SIs) during ERP implementations.
  • Microsoft D365 certifications, particularly in Supply Chain Management or related modules.
  • Fluent Spanish.

Morgan Advanced Materials is an EEO/AA/M/W/D/V Employer Ind-1

Morgan Advanced Materials is a business rich in history and innovation. Founded in the UK in 1856, we have grown into a global organisation with 70 sites in 18 countries. Our model to serve our customers where they need us has led to a diversified product range using our unparalleled expertise in ceramic and carbon materials, which we exploit to solve difficult problems for our customers across a diverse range of markets.

We are a purpose driven organisation. Our purpose is to use advanced materials to make the world more sustainable and to improve the quality of life. We deliver on that purpose through the products that we make, and the way that we make them.

We help our customers push the limits of their processes and products to meet the demanding requirements they face, from higher process temperatures to higher product performance to increasing miniaturisation.

Key Figures: Revenue £1,100.7m (2024), ~8,000 employees, manufacturing in 20+ countries, and a global customer portfolio. A UK PLC with head office located in Windsor, Berkshire UK. Listed on London Stock Exchange; Member of the FTSE 250 Index.

raw.description:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

About the Role

As Lead Technical Recruiter, you will lead critical technical searches, raise recruiting quality across the team and help build Act's technical recruiting capability.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead ActAI's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile.

  • Build search strategies and talent maps for scarce technical talent across global AI and engineering markets.

  • Personally source, engage, assess and close senior and difficult-to-hire candidates.

  • Set a high bar for technical profile assessment, ensuring recruiters understand candidates' actual work, technical depth and relevance before progressing them.

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to define hiring profiles, calibrate interview standards and diagnose gaps in the recruiting funnel.

  • Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing.

  • Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly.

  • Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as Act scales.

What You Will Need

  • 7+ years of technical recruiting experience, including significant ownership of senior and difficult engineering searches.

  • Strong track record hiring high-quality engineers through direct sourcing and headhunting.

  • Deep familiarity with technical talent markets and strong understanding of software engineering and AI/ML profiles.

  • Ability to distinguish exceptional technical work from strong branding, titles or CV keywords.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior engineering leaders on hiring strategy and calibration.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach recruiters and improve the quality of their sourcing and assessment.

  • Strong judgement, urgency and willingness to remain deeply hands-on.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or leading technical recruiting at an AI company or high-growth technology startup.

  • Existing networks across AI/ML and engineering communities.

  • Experience hiring across multiple markets including the US, Europe and Asia.

raw.title: Lead Account Executive, State & Local Government
raw.excerpt: What's the role? As a Lead Account Executive, State & Local Government, you will lead HERE’s strategic relationships with State Departments of Transportation and help shape the next phase of our State & Local Government business in the United States.
raw.description:
What's the role?

As a Lead Account Executive, State & Local Government, you will lead HERE’s strategic relationships with State Departments of Transportation and help shape the next phase of our State & Local Government business in the United States.

You’ll own a strategic portfolio centered on State DOTs, along with select major cities, counties, and regional transportation organizations. This is a senior, quota-carrying role where you’ll balance growing established customer relationships with creating new opportunities across traffic operations, roadway safety, GIS, mobility, infrastructure planning, transportation modernization, and public safety.

You will:

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic State DOT and State & Local Government accounts, expanding existing business while creating new revenue opportunities.
  • Develop account strategies aligned with agency priorities, programs, funding, procurement cycles, and long-term transportation initiatives.
  • Build trusted relationships across agency leadership, traffic operations, GIS, planning, safety, engineering, IT, and procurement.
  • Identify opportunities to apply HERE capabilities across location intelligence, traffic, GIS, routing, mobility, roadway safety, and analytics.
  • Lead complex sales cycles from discovery and solution development through RFPs, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.
  • Expand HERE’s presence within existing customers by developing new use cases, relationships, and programs, often in partnership with HERE Solution Partners.
  • Mobilize HERE product, technical, commercial, and partner teams around strategic customer opportunities.
  • Maintain strong account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
  • Represent HERE across the U.S. transportation, geospatial, and public-sector community.

Who are you?

You are an experienced enterprise seller who knows how to navigate complex customer organizations, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and turn transportation and public-sector challenges into meaningful business opportunities.

You bring:

  • 8+ years of enterprise or complex solution sales experience, ideally within transportation, geospatial technology, infrastructure, enterprise technology, or the public sector.
  • A demonstrated track record of achieving revenue goals, growing strategic accounts, and developing new business.
  • Experience navigating complex government organizations, procurement processes, RFPs, contracting, and extended sales cycles.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships across senior, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic account planning, negotiation, commercial, and closing capabilities.
  • The ability to translate agency priorities and transportation challenges into compelling customer solutions and business opportunities.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and mobilizing resources without direct authority.
  • The ability to travel primarily within the United States as business needs require.

Ideally, you’ll also bring experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Selling directly to State DOTs or other transportation agencies.
  • Established relationships across the U.S. transportation, infrastructure, or GIS community.
  • Location intelligence, mapping, GIS, traffic, mobility, roadway safety, transportation data, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
  • Traffic operations, roadway safety, GIS modernization, infrastructure planning, or mobility programs.
  • Working with solution providers within the State DOT traffic operations ecosystem.
  • State government procurement, contracting, and RFP processes.
  • The Esri ecosystem or relationships with transportation technology, engineering, and consulting partners.

Why HERE?

HERE combines global location data, enterprise-grade technology and deep real-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.

The expected base salary range for this position is $154,000 - $220,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.
