Job Purpose

We are seeking a skilled ServiceNow Developer with a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience to design, develop, and implement solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Customer Service Management (CSM), Knowledge Management (Knowledge Base), IT Service Management (ITSM), and ServiceNow Communities.

About Product & Technology

Product & Technology plays a pivotal role in aligning the organization with its strategic objectives and enhancing shareholder value. Product & Technology is responsible for establishing unified standards and governance practices throughout the company. Additionally, we oversee the development and maintenance of core applications essential for the seamless operation of various functions across the organization. We are committed to driving and executing future roadmaps that are in line with the overall strategic direction of RWS.

With a global reach, Product & Technology provides support services to over 7500 end users worldwide. We take pride in managing the information security operation and safeguarding all our assets. Our core functions encompass Enterprise & Technical Architecture, Network & Voice, Infrastructure, Service Delivery, Service Operations, Data & Analytics, Security & Quality Compliance, Transformation, Application Development, Enterprise Platforms, With a dedicated team of over 500 staff, Product & Technology ensures a strong presence across all regions, enabling efficient and effective support to our global operations.

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement ServiceNow solutions aligned with business requirements
  • Customize and configure modules including CSM, ITSM, Knowledge Base, and ServiceNow Communities
  • Develop workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and integrations
  • Maintain and enhance existing ServiceNow applications and services
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Ensure platform best practices, performance optimization, and scalability
  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues and defects
  • Support platform upgrades, testing, and deployments
  • Create and maintain technical documentation

Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 4 years of ServiceNow development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • Customer Service Management (CSM)
  • IT Service Management (ITSM)
  • Knowledge Management / Knowledge Base
  • ServiceNow Communities (Service Portal experience is a plus)
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, Glide API, and ServiceNow scripting
  • Experience with REST/SOAP integrations
  • Good understanding of ServiceNow data model and platform capabilities
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge of CMDB (Configuration Management Database) and asset management
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery or Service Mapping
  • Experience with Knowledge Centred Services (KCS) methodology
  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CAD)
  • Experience with UI Builder or modern ServiceNow UX frameworks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in ITIL-based service management environments.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, and ServiceNow AI capabilities.
  • ServiceNow Administrator Certification (CSA) is an advantage; Advanced certifications (CIS-ITSM, CIS-CSM, or CIS-ITOM) are a plus.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar professional experience is highly desirable.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with a dynamic team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Continuous learning and career development opportunities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements and remote work options.

If you are a passionate and experienced ServiceNow Developer looking to advance your career and make a significant impact, we invite you to apply today!

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

raw.description:
IQVIA Biotech is a unique division specialising in working with smaller biotech and emerging biopharma clients and as such we have a vibrant, fast-paced working environment. The sector we are in is cutting edge for therapies with un-met medical need.

IQVIA Biotech has an exciting position within its EU Clinical Monitoring team. The Clinical Monitoring department is the largest team within IQVIA Biotech, providing CRA, Clinical Leads, Management and oversight to global clinical studies.

Please note, for this role you must be based in Belgium

Basic Functions:

Participates in the preparation and execution of Phase I-IV clinical trials. Oversees the progress of clinical investigations by conducting site evaluation, initiation, and interim close out visits to sites. Monitors clinical trials in accordance with Good Clinical Practices and procedures set forth by IQVIA Biotech and sponsors. Works closely with the Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) and/or Lead CRA to ensure all monitoring activities are conducted according to study requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in the investigator recruitment process, performing site evaluation visits of potential investigators to evaluate the capability of the site to successfully manage and conduct the clinical study.

  • Coordinate activities with the site and internal departments in preparation for the initiation of the study. Performs study initiation activities, reviewing with the site personnel the protocol, regulatory issues, study procedures, and provides training on completion of the eCRF and EDC system; monitoring activities and study close-out activities.

  • Assists in resolving any issues to ensure compliance with site file audits in conjunction with ISS.

  • Assures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, investigator integrity, and compliance with all study procedures through on-site monitoring visits. Performs validation of source documentation as required by sponsor. Prepares monitoring reports and letters per the timelines defined in IQVIA Biotech SOPs.

  • Documents accountability, stability and storage conditions of clinical trial materials as required by sponsor. Performs investigational product inventory.

  • Reviews the quality and integrity of the clinical data through (1) in house review of electronic CRF data and (2) on-site source verification and works with sites to resolve data queries and produce robust data.

  • May review protocols, eCRFs, study manuals and other related documents, as requested by the Clinical Trial Manager and/or Lead CRA.

  • Serves as primary contact between IQVIA Biotech and investigator; coordinates all correspondence; ensures timely transmission of clinical data with the study site and technical reporting, as requested.

  • Assists with, and attends, Investigator Meetings for assigned studies.

  • Attends study-related, company, departmental, and external meetings, as required.

  • Ensures all study deliverables are completed per IQVIA Biotech and study timelines

  • Conducts Field Evaluation Visits and field training of CRA Is, IIs and other Sr. CRAs.

  • Serves as mentor for junior CRAs and those new to the company and/or study.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong knowledge of clinical research process, including working knowledge of all functional areas of clinical trials and medical terminology.

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of onsite monitoring experience is a must.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to express complex ideas to study personnel at research and clinical institutions.

  • Able to form productive professional relationships both internally within own function, cross-functionally and externally with health care professionals.

  • Able to handle several priorities within multiple, complex trials.

  • Able to reason independently and recommend specific solutions in clinical settings.

  • Able to work independently, prioritize, and work within a matrix team environment.

  • Knowledge of current GCP/ICH guidelines applicable to the conduct of clinical research.

  • Candidates must have strong communication levels of Dutch and English (French is a plus)

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Every hour of every day, soldiers, acquisition professionals, and federal partners around the world count on systems that simply cannot go down. That is where PL ALTESS comes in. As the Agile Center of Excellence for the Program Executive Office Enterprise (PEO Enterprise), the U.S. Army Product Lead Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology Enterprise Systems and Services (PL ALTESS) runs enterprise-class data centers that host hundreds of programs, thousands of virtual servers, and millions of users worldwide, 24x7x365. Our team delivers the full spectrum of IT services: data center and Service Operations Center operations, network and systems administration, cybersecurity, cloud and application modernization, disaster recovery, and lifecycle testing across physical, virtual, and cloud architectures spanning multiple geographic locations. If you want your work to matter at mission scale, this is the place.

The opportunity: You will be the Citrix authority on the ALTESS Windows team, designing and running the Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, NetScaler, StoreFront, and Director platforms that put mission applications in users' hands securely and reliably.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, install, maintain, and troubleshoot Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (formerly XenApp), NetScaler Gateway, Citrix StoreFront, and Citrix Director.
  • Manage, maintain, deploy, and support Windows Server 2019/2022 systems across a mixed customer environment.
  • Plan, execute, and implement new system hardware and software, and lead new HW/SW integrations.
  • Monitor and tune system performance, harden servers, and report on security and operational status.
  • Automate routine work with PowerShell, and produce utilization reports that drive corrective actions.
  • Manage the lifecycle of multi-vendor data center equipment, including firmware version control and preventive maintenance.
  • Create and maintain team technical instructions, operating procedures, and policies.
  • Recommend, demonstrate, and implement technologies that expand, upgrade, and increase efficiency in the environment.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIRED)

  • Minimum of 12 years w/o a degree; Minimum of 10 years with AS/AA; Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
  • DoD 8140 qualified for DCWF 451 – System Administrator at the Intermediate proficiency level
  • Computing environment / platform certification for the technologies supported (e.g., Citrix CCP-V or current Citrix/NetScaler certification, Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+); may be waived for 30 days after project start
  • Background in Computer Science or IT.
  • Active DoW Secret security clearance
  • US Citizenship
  • 5+ years as a Windows Systems Administrator or Engineer designing, installing, and maintaining Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp), NetScaler Gateway, Citrix StoreFront, and Citrix Director.
  • 3+ years automating tasks with PowerShell.
  • 3+ years installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting complex applications and websites (IIS, Apache, etc.).
  • 3+ years in complex networking environments, with senior-level knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SMTP, and SNMP.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a team-player mindset.

WHAT SETS YOU APART (DESIRED)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent years of experience.
  • 3+ years supporting cybersecurity patch management, STIGs, SRGs, RMF, SCA-V, and CORA.
  • 3+ years managing enterprise-level Active Directory structures.
  • 3+ years creating and maintaining complex Microsoft Group Policy implementations.
  • 3+ years creating, maintaining, and following SOPs for repeatable processes, disaster recovery, and common problem resolution.
  • 3+ years configuring and maintaining key services such as DNS, SFTP, SMTP, and NTP.

WORKLOCATION:

  • Radford, VA or Remote

Ready to keep the mission running? Apply today and join the team that keeps Army enterprise systems up 24x7x365.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

  • Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

  • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

  • Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

  • Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

  • Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

  • Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

  • Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

Who You Are

  • Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

  • Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

  • Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

  • Owner: You take ownership of outcomes and are comfortable building process where none exists yet.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining 2+ years at a reputable investment bank, corporate development group, or private equity firm with 2+ years in strategic finance or FP&A at a high-growth company.

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a similarly quantitative field.

  • Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based operating models, three-statement mechanics, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and a working command of accounting concepts and GAAP.

  • Experience with unit economics in a consumer or marketplace business, including CAC, LTV, payback, cohort retention, and contribution margin.

  • A track record of translating complex analysis into a clear narrative for an executive or investor audience.

  • Startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred, including building financial processes from scratch.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for analysis, research, and workflow automation.

Nice to have:

  • Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or marketplace experience;

  • CFA certification;

  • vendor negotiation or procurement exposure;

  • finance tech stack experience (NetSuite, Ramp, planning tools).

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We partner with local governments at the enterprise level, as well as within and across departments, to meet the most critical needs of their community, emphasizing principles of equity and engagement. Our EDT practice focuses on working with municipal clients (cities, counties, schools, and special districts) to address business process transformation initiatives, including: process and policy assessments/gap analyses; software assessments and replacement planning; as well as providing client-side project management as clients implement new software solutions. Our team combines expertise in technology, operations, and software system processes to help clients navigate complex organizational and technological change.

We are passionate about the work we perform, supporting our clients and our own team members, and we have fun in the process.

We have worked with hundreds of government agencies throughout the United States. We understand the needs of public sector agencies, their fiscal constraints, and the commitment to serving constituents. Upon joining our EDT practice, you can expect to receive guidance from the supervisor(s), consultants, or principal in charge of an engagement or project within LGPG. Work performed will be closely supervised through coaching and training. With guidance from staff members of the EDT practice and LGPG, you will become familiar with the firm’s systems, operations, and relationships. The firm expects you to demonstrate flexibility, have a willingness to seek out advice, and exhibit an ambition for learning.

You will work with a mix of high-performing teams offering a variety of projects in a fast-paced environment with many opportunities for personal and professional growth. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with many different stakeholders within local government.

You will serve as a Project Manager, working with BerryDunn and our client project teams as they plan for and select new enterprise software systems. The successful candidate will lead software system assessment and selection/procurement projects involving many systems used by local governments including, but not limited to, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Information Systems (CIS), and related best-of-breed software systems.

You will bring a mix of demonstrated project management capabilities, exceptional organizational and self-management qualities, strong leadership capabilities, effective written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to travel to build effective client relationships. You will be responsible for the day-to-day analysis of requirements, design and documentation while taking the longer view in your planning and communication. Your experience in planning for and selecting enterprise software for a public sector organization will make you a trusted advisor to our local government clients and a valued member of our team.

This team member will have the flexibility to be located out of either our Portland, Maine office, or as a remote employee based in the East or Central region. You will be joining a team that includes both office-based and remote colleagues. This position will support client engagements nationwide, primarily supporting large enterprise organizations. As a result, this position will require occasional work outside the selected candidates’ standard 8am-5pm business hours.

  • Analyze current-state client business processes and identify opportunities for operational and technology improvements.
  • Develop concise summaries, reports, and presentations of complex data for client leadership.
  • Extend yourself beyond the demands of current assignments and responsibilities and accept new assignments.
  • Participate in staff/team meetings and training and work effectively as a collaborator on multiple client projects.
  • Partner with client staff to develop and administer procurement activities, including: project scoping, Request for Proposal (RFP) development, software demonstrations, reference checks, site visits, and contract scoping
  • Communicate project and delivery status to our clients, team members, and other stakeholders, including the facilitation of client meetings
  • Supervise assigned team members on engagement teams, working with group managers to address development and performance needs to achieve a high performing team
  • Participate in marketing and business development activities, including writing blog posts, attending conferences, participating in industry groups, leading/participating in prospective client business development meetings
  • Reviewing Requests for Proposals (RFPs) opportunities for prospective new client work and assist with go/no-go decision-making, as well as proposal development in collaboration with BerryDunn’s Business Development team
  • Perform assigned administrative tasks effectively and efficiently, asking questions when instructions are unclear

You Have

  • BA/BS Degree in a technical field or related, relevant work experience
  • 4 to 8 years of professional experience, preferably in a Business/Technical Analyst or Project Manager role
  • While not a requirement, applicants with prior experience working within local government organizations, management/technology consulting experience, or prior ERP implementation experience, are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • A current PMP certification, the equivalent project management experience; or, the passion to obtain a PMP certification
  • Excellence in the areas of time management, flexibility, and attention to details.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities to autonomously achieve quality results in a timely manner
  • Ability to work across time zones
  • Ability to use problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills to resolve project issues
  • Ability to remain highly responsive to internal and external communications
  • A positive, “can do” demeanor that encourages and motivates others
  • Strong computer skills
  • Experience facilitating meetings and public speaking with large groups
  • Ability to build and sustain positive working relationships with diverse teams
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, adapting to changing dynamics and priorities in order to meet established deadlines
  • High-quality communication skills, including both in written form and verbal
  • Knowledge of quality assurance/control procedures and demonstrated proactive problem management skills
  • Motivation to be a team member
  • Willingness and ability to travel

Compensation Details

This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

Senior Director, Full-Service Sales

About Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc.

At SBH, our purpose is to inspire a more colorful, confident, and welcoming world. We are the leader in professional hair color, selling and distributing professional beauty supplies across 11 countries through our Sally Beauty and Beauty Systems Group businesses. Sally Beauty offers products for hair color, hair care, nails, and skin care to retail customers looking for salon quality products at a value price. Beauty Systems Group, branded as Cosmo Prof or Armstrong McCall stores, along with its direct sales consultants, sell professionally branded products intended for use and resale by salons to retail consumers.

About the role

The Senior Director, Full-Service Sales is a senior field leader responsible for the performance, talent, and strategic direction of a large, complex Full-Service region. This role leads a team of Full-Service Leaders to deliver sales growth, profitability, customer retention, and new business development while building organizational capability across the region.

The Senior Director operates as the regional general manager for Full Service—translating company strategy into regional execution, developing leadership bench strength, strengthening vendor and cross-functional partnerships, and driving consistent performance standards across multiple markets. In addition to owning regional results, the Senior Director is expected to influence the broader field organization through best-practice sharing, leadership of key initiatives, and contribution to organizational design, training, and talent planning.

Typical span of control: 6–8 Full-Service Leaders leading a large, multi-state region with elevated business, people, and market complexity.

Responsibilities

Grow the Business – 45%

  • Own the performance of a large Full-Service region, delivering against sales, gross margin, new customer acquisition, customer retention, productivity, and profitability targets.
  • Translate company strategy into a regional operating plan, including priorities by market, account segmentation, talent deployment, and focus areas for growth.
  • Lead through Full-Service Leaders to drive execution of sales plans, promotional priorities, key account strategies, and new business development across the region.
  • Review monthly and quarterly regional performance, identify performance gaps, and direct corrective action plans across territories and leaders.
  • Ensure regional forecasting accuracy through disciplined review of sales trends, pipeline opportunities, risks, and productivity indicators.
  • Coach Full-Service Leaders to use Salesforce, Tableau, and other business tools to identify opportunities related to customer growth, order trends, assortment gaps, event participation, returns, and vendor opportunities.
  • Serve as the senior regional partner for vendor/manufacturer relationships, including strategic market planning, education alignment, business development days, and key customer engagement.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders in stores, merchandising, supply chain, pricing, and finance to resolve issues, improve execution, and unlock growth.
  • Lead the regional business narrative for Quarterly Business Reviews, including performance, key risks, talent health, and recommended actions.

Lead the Team and Build Organizational Capability – 45%

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Full-Service Leaders, holding them accountable for territory performance, recruiting, onboarding, coaching, talent development, and execution consistency.
  • Build and maintain a strong regional leadership bench by identifying succession candidates, accelerating high-potential leaders, and addressing performance gaps decisively.
  • Own regional talent planning, including org design recommendations, territory leadership needs, and hiring plans in partnership with HR and Talent Acquisition.
  • Establish a consistent leadership operating rhythm across the region, including one-on-ones, performance reviews, field coaching, business reviews, and development planning.
  • Spend meaningful time in market with Full-Service Leaders to assess leadership effectiveness, coaching quality, customer engagement, and territory execution; provide direct feedback and action plans.
  • Drive accountability for associate experience, retention, engagement, and culture across the region.
  • Partner with Full-Service Leaders to address underperformance, performance management actions, and associate relations matters in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Lead onboarding and development standards for Full-Service Leaders across the region and contribute to broader field leadership training where appropriate.
  • Share best practices across regions and play an active role in shaping field leadership standards, role clarity, and productivity expectations.

Enterprise Leadership / Strategic Projects – 10%

  • Model enterprise leadership by balancing regional priorities with broader company goals and acting as a visible culture leader across the Full-Service organization.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Who You Are

  • Customer-Centric: You excel at building and maintaining strong customer relationships, understanding each customer’s unique needs, and identifying how PermitFlow can support their success and growth. You are comfortable and thrive at connecting with customers virtually – spearheading meetings and serving as the face of PermitFlow in all your interactions.

  • Construction Permitting Expert: You have extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting directly, with a thorough understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle. You’re excited about this space and the construction industry at large.

  • Team Player: You’re a key contributor to the pilot process, ensuring a seamless customer journey from software adoption to full implementation. Collaboration is your strength, and you thrive in a cross-functional environment.

  • Analytical Thinker: You’re data-driven in your decision-making. You know how to gather, interpret, and leverage data to enhance customer conversations and improve processes.

  • Tech-Forward & Adaptable: You’re comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve workflows and customer outcomes. You’re eager to learn and implement new software features, and you adapt quickly — ready and able to pivot to new processes at a moment’s notice.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Point of Contact: Serve as the primary resource for customers, keeping them informed on permit status, timelines, and requirements.

  • Team Development: You are comfortable providing clear training, coaching, feedback, and direction to junior team members and oversee their work. You have the skillset to effectively manage a team, hold 1:1s with them, and empower them to learn more.

  • Manage the Permit Process: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of permit applications, including researching requirements, preparing forms, gathering documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant authorities.

  • Generate Reports: Produce detailed reports on permit progress, delivering regular, clear updates to customers and stakeholders.

  • Optimize Processes: Continuously identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices that streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance and Accuracy: Guarantee that all permit applications are complete, accurate, and compliant with jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Monitor and Expedite Approvals: Track permit statuses proactively, engaging with authorities to move applications forward as efficiently as possible.

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience: Proven track record in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role—ideally within a SaaS or tech-driven environment.

  • Local Permitting Knowledge: Hands-on, working knowledge of the permitting landscape across the Midwest, with priority given to candidates deeply familiar with Minnesota, Michigan, Iowa, and Wisconsin specifically, plus general familiarity with permitting practices across other Midwest states.

  • Established Municipal Relationships: Existing relationships with municipalities and inspectors in these states — someone who brings local trust and rapport on day one rather than having to build it from scratch.

  • Regional Escalation Point: Comfortable acting as the on-the-ground point of escalation when local jurisdictions push back on remote or third-party submissions.

  • Expediter Unblocking: Demonstrated ability to identify and unblock restrictions that municipalities place specifically on third-party permit expediters, and a track record of working through (or around) those restrictions to keep permits moving.

  • Exceptional project management skills: Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • Outstanding communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally, manage customer relationships, and collaborate with AHJs.

  • Leadership experience: Preferred 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

Field Sales Representative

Location: Doncaster, covering Doncaster or surrounding areas such as Mexborough, Thorne or Bawtry (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Stage 3 - Final Assessment (60 minutes)
You’ll meet members of our Sales leadership team, present a short territory plan and take part in a practical sales role-play. We’ll share everything you need to prepare in advance.

We know interviews are a two-way process, and we’ll make sure you have plenty of opportunities to ask questions and get to know us along the way.

Teya is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those without a traditional sales or commercial track record.

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.

raw.description:
About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure.

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Engineer, Cyber Engineering to design, build, automate, and operate scalable security infrastructure across endpoint, network, cloud, and enterprise security platforms.

This role is intended for an engineering-minded security professional who treats infrastructure as code, automation as the default, and manual configuration as technical debt. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering principles to cybersecurity, replacing traditional ClickOps with GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and repeatable, self-service security capabilities.

You will help advance Riot's cybersecurity engineering maturity by modernizing how security services are planned, built, deployed, operated, and continuously improved—delivering secure, reliable, observable, and highly automated platforms that scale with our growing AI/HPC and data center infrastructure.

This position will be remote with travel to Riot office locations as needed.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise security capabilities across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity platforms, including EDR/XDR, SASE, firewalls, and security telemetry.
  • Embed security into infrastructure, cloud, and application delivery pipelines using reusable, standardized security architectures.
  • Establish GitOps as the default operating model, with version-controlled configurations, peer reviews, automated testing, and approved deployment pipelines.
  • Build reusable IaC modules and templates with policy-as-code, configuration validation, and automated drift detection and remediation for repeatable, auditable deployments.
  • Eliminate toil by automating the security Plan, Build, and Run lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment through monitoring, troubleshooting, and remediation.
  • Improve platform reliability with SRE practices, including health checks, automated alerting, self-healing, rollback, and disaster recovery.
  • Measure engineering performance through deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, recovery time, configuration drift, and automation coverage.
  • Lead complex initiatives from architecture through production, set engineering standards, mentor engineers, and evaluate emerging tools such as AI-assisted and agentic automation.

What you'll have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, platform, or software engineering, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise security systems.
  • Hands-on expertise with enterprise security platforms such as CrowdStrike, Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Microsoft Defender, and SIEM/SOAR.
  • Advanced proficiency in Terraform, GitOps, and CI/CD, with a track record of replacing manual administration with code-driven infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and REST APIs, applying software engineering best practices such as testing, code reviews, and documentation.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Ansible, Kubernetes, Docker, or comparable platforms.
  • Knowledge of NIST CSF, SOC 2, and ISO 27001, including compliance automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and cross-team collaboration skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives independently.
  • Preferred: cybersecurity, cloud, or Terraform certifications and experience with AI-assisted engineering, AI/HPC, or large-scale data center environments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: $160,000-$175,000 (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

This role must be based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area.

Who You Are

  • Customer-Centric: You excel at building and maintaining strong customer relationships, understanding each customer’s unique needs, and identifying how PermitFlow can support their success and growth. You are comfortable and thrive at connecting with customers virtually – spearheading meetings and serving as the face of PermitFlow in all your interactions.

  • Construction Permitting Expert: You have extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting directly, with a thorough understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle. You’re excited about this space and the construction industry at large.

  • Team Player: You’re a key contributor to the customer journey from software adoption to full implementation. Collaboration is your strength, and you thrive in a cross-functional environment.

  • Analytical Thinker: You’re data-driven in your decision-making. You know how to gather, interpret, and leverage data to enhance customer conversations and improve processes.

  • Tech-Forward & Adaptable: You’re comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve workflows and customer outcomes. You’re eager to learn and implement new software features, and you adapt quickly — ready and able to pivot to new processes at a moment’s notice.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Point of Contact: Serve as the primary resource for customers, keeping them informed on permit status, timelines, and requirements.

  • Team Development: You are comfortable providing clear training, coaching, feedback, and direction to junior team members and oversee their work. You have the skillset to effectively manage a team, hold 1:1s with them, and empower them to learn more.

  • Manage the Permit Process: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of permit applications, including researching requirements, preparing forms, gathering documentation, and submitting applications to the relevant authorities.

  • Generate Reports: Produce detailed reports on permit progress, delivering regular, clear updates to customers and stakeholders.

  • Optimize Processes: Continuously identify opportunities for improvement, implementing best practices that streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance operational efficiency.

  • Ensure Compliance and Accuracy: Guarantee that all permit applications are complete, accurate, and compliant with jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Monitor and Expedite Approvals: Track permit statuses proactively, engaging with authorities to move applications forward as efficiently as possible.

Qualifications & Fit

  • 3-5+ years of relevant experience: Proven track record in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role—ideally within a SaaS or tech-driven environment.

  • Bilingual: English and French

  • Location: Based in Ontario or willing to relocate to the area

  • Permitting Expert: Experience with residential or commercial permitting in Quebec, including direct work with municipalities. Strong understanding of permitting processes, regulations, and compliance standards, with awareness of jurisdictional differences.

  • Exceptional project management skills: Ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines without sacrificing attention to detail.

  • Outstanding communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally, manage customer relationships, and collaborate with AHJs.

  • Leadership experience: Preferred 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Customer-centric mindset: Background in customer success, customer experience, or sales, with a demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality service throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Critical thinker and problem-solver: Able to stay calm under pressure, quickly assess challenges, and identify effective solutions.

What We Offer (Full Time Roles Only)

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Job Summary

CRS strives to promote the health, safety and well-being of all staff. As part of this approach, CRS considers health and well-being an integral aspect of our success. This role will be responsible for strategically designing, leading, and implementing staff care and well-being strategies at both the individual, group and organizational levels. As part of the Health, Safety and Security Unit (HSSU) and member of the HSS Senior Management Team, the Senior Advisor, Staff Well-Being and Workforce Resilience will oversee capacity strengthening in staff care and resilience practices, psychosocial critical incident response, and global well-being initiatives.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:

  • Lead the technical development, implementation, and continuous improvement of CRS’ Staff Care and Well-Being strategy, procedures, standards, and frameworks to ensure alignment with organizational priorities, duty of care commitments, risk management strategies, workforce needs, and operational effectiveness.
  • Develop and oversee a psychosocial risk assessment framework, including standardized assessment and documentation tools that can be adapted and scaled across countries and regions to identify, monitor, and address emerging psychosocial risks.
  • Advise country and regional teams, and leadership on strategies and practices that promote staff well-being, resilience, and operational effectiveness, with particular attention to high-risk, insecure, emergency, humanitarian, disaster, and other high-stress operating environments.

Crisis Response:

  • Facilitate preparedness activities and psychosocial risk mitigation efforts for country programs operating in high-risk, insecure, and crisis-affected contexts.
  • Lead agency-wide Family Liaison Program, including liaison training curriculum development, program oversight, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Translate clinical knowledge into technical/operation guidance to country and regional teams, and leadership during and following critical incidents, emergencies, security incidents (road traffic accidents, detentions, physical or sexual violence, etc.), and other situations that may adversely affect staff well-being.
  • Coordinate referrals during/after critical incidents to appropriate resources

Capacity Building and Technical Assistance:

  • Design and deliver in-person and remote training and capacity-strengthening initiatives for CRS staff, managers, and leaders, with particular emphasis on strengthening preparedness, resilience, psychosocial support, and stress management in high-risk and high-stress operating environments.
  • Develop evidence-informed guidance, tools, and resources grounded in psychological science, mental health care research, and trauma-informed principles and adapt them for use across CRS organizational and operating contexts.
  • Strengthen leadership and manager capacity to recognize, address, and mitigate psychosocial risks affecting individuals, teams, and organizational performance.
  • Facilitate agency-wide learning opportunities, community of practice, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that promote effective staff care and well-being practices across CRS and, where appropriate, partner organizations.

Supervision, Monitoring, Evaluation, Reporting:

  • Supervise and provide technical direction to Technical Advisor and/or consultant responsible for supporting agency-wide staff care and well-being activities.
  • Monitor and track progress toward strategic objectives and key performance indicators and recommend adjustments to strengthen effectiveness, sustainability, and organizational impact.

Key Working Relationships

  • Internal: HSSU, Regional and Deputy Regional Directors, Sr. Director of Health, Safety and Security, Country Representatives and Managers, Heads of Operations, Heads of Programs, HSS Focal Points, HR, Program Quality (including Health programming team), Ethics Unit, General Counsel, and Humanitarian Response Department.
  • External: International and local mental health providers, Employee Assistance Program vendors, contracted medical service providers and peers/peer networks in public and private sector.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Demonstrates ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed team with strong relationship building skills to work collaboratively and effectively with key stakeholders across functions, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience working in sensitive situations with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in virtual collaboration and communication technologies (e.g., Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, intranet, email, phone, text messaging, webinar platforms, and shared workspaces),
  • Self-motivated to meet deadlines with evidence of problem solving and critical thinking
  • Ability to train and convey information to a variety of personnel on various skill and language levels
  • Able and willing to work flexible hours when needed, including off-hours and weekends for critical incident response
  • Provide effective remote supervision and/or coaching, and support to staff, consultants, and stakeholders worldwide.

  • Demonstrated experience transferring knowledge to diverse audiences through training, mentoring, and other formal and informal methods

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Every hour of every day, soldiers, acquisition professionals, and federal partners around the world count on systems that simply cannot go down. That is where PL ALTESS comes in. As the Agile Center of Excellence for the Program Executive Office Enterprise (PEO Enterprise), the U.S. Army Product Lead Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology Enterprise Systems and Services (PL ALTESS) runs enterprise-class data centers that host hundreds of programs, thousands of virtual servers, and millions of users worldwide, 24x7x365. Our team delivers the full spectrum of IT services: data center and Service Operations Center operations, network and systems administration, cybersecurity, cloud and application modernization, disaster recovery, and lifecycle testing across physical, virtual, and cloud architectures spanning multiple geographic locations. If you want your work to matter at mission scale, this is the place.

The opportunity: RMF is how mission systems earn and keep their authority to operate, and you will drive it. From eMASS packages to POA&Ms, ACAS and STIG remediation, and COOP testing, you will keep an enterprise of Army systems compliant and audit-ready.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Provide Enterprise eMASS and RMF services in line with DoWI 8500.01, DoWI 8510.01, and AR 25-2.
  • Develop RMF packages and maintain asset lists and system categorizations.
  • Schedule and coordinate system validation reviews.
  • Generate artifacts that support control compliance.
  • Review ACAS and STIG reports and coordinate remediation.
  • Create, track, and maintain Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Perform annual security reviews and take part in COOP and Incident Response testing.
  • Maintain Army PPSM and Circuit Registry records, and document Software Assurance review items in eMASS POA&Ms.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIRED)

  • Minimum of 12 years w/o a degree; Minimum of 10 years with AS/AA; Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA;
  • DoD 8140 qualified for DCWF 722 – Information Systems Security Manager at the Intermediate proficiency level
  • Active DoW Secret security clearance
  • US Citizenship
  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity and RMF-related areas.
  • Extensive experience with Enterprise eMASS and RMF services.
  • Proficiency developing RMF packages and maintaining asset lists and categorizations.
  • Ability to schedule and coordinate system validation reviews.
  • Experience generating artifacts that support control compliance.
  • Knowledge of ACAS and STIG reports and coordinating remediation efforts.
  • Experience creating, tracking, and maintaining POA&Ms.
  • Ability to perform annual security reviews.

raw.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experienced with kids and families. You have 3+ years of clinical or community nutrition experience, ideally in pediatric or family-focused settings.

  • Skilled in weight and metabolic health. You've supported patients with obesity, overweight, or metabolic conditions, and you know how to talk about weight in ways that build trust instead of shame.

  • A confident group facilitator. You can keep a virtual room of kids or caregivers engaged, and you enjoy it.

  • Comfortable with virtual care. You use EMRs and telehealth platforms with ease and document efficiently.

  • Culturally responsive. You've worked with families from diverse backgrounds and tailor your recommendations to their culture, resources, and goals.

  • A builder at heart. You're energized by a fast-growing startup and happy to iterate on new care models.

  • Ready to serve our Medicaid families. You're enrolled in California or Texas Medicaid, or willing to enroll.

Bonus points

  • State dietitian licensure, or openness to obtaining licenses with support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group.

  • Spanish fluency.

Compensation, Schedule and Benefits

The pay range for this role is 40–50 per hour, depending on experience. You're paid for all time worked, including visits, group sessions, prep, and documentation.

This is a part-time, hourly W-2 role, fully remote. You choose your hours within our operating window of Monday through Friday, 2pm–8pm PT. This role is eligible for sick leave and 401k participation.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Clarity, we believe every family deserves care that sees and understands them, and that starts with the team we build. Our patients and their families come from every background, community, and walk of life, and we're at our best when our team reflects that diversity. As a female-led company, we know firsthand that different perspectives lead to better decisions, better technology, and better care for kids.

We're building a workplace where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong, and where trust is earned and extended to all. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those whose experience doesn't match every line of this description. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Clarity Pediatrics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please let us know at .

Recruitment Fraud Notice

Clarity Pediatrics will never ask candidates for payment, bank account details, or sensitive personal information such as a Social Security number during the application or interview process. We will never ask you to buy equipment or send money as a condition of employment. All communication from our team will come from an @ email address or through Ashby, and we do not make job offers over text message or chat apps alone.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Clarity, please don't respond. Report it to us at . You can also report it to the FTC at .
