We scale virtual access to multi-specialty care, putting all the care a family needs in one place. We are turning a chaotic, fragmented and expensive care journey into a clear path forward.

Now is a great time to join - we just closed a substantial Series A, which means we have runway, ambition and a growing team. Since inception, we’ve raised $25M from leading VCs who invested early in category winners like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Alto Pharmacy, Strava, and Tia.

Our Culture

We’re building a team of clinicians who are collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering exceptional care. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Co-founded by a pediatric provider, with exceptional clinical leaders including licensed mental health providers in key roles shaping every major decision

  • Clinical model built to partner closely with referring providers

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration and robust case consultation opportunities

  • A diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven community where your voice matters

  • Access to expert clinical guidance from ADHD and anxiety specialists and researchers

  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and training

What We Offer

We’re committed to taking care of the healthcare providers who care for our patients. Our benefits include:

  • Part-time compensation:

    • Clinical Hourly Rate: $62.00–$84.00 per completed session

    • Administrative Hourly Rate: $25.00 per hour for non-clinical time (documentation, meetings, admin).

  • Flexible part-time hours: 8–25 hours per week (totaling clinical and admin time), with a maximum of 8 working hours per day.

  • Flexible scheduling within our operating hours (7 am – 8 pm PT, Monday–Saturday).

  • A dedicated care coordination team to support with administrative tasks (e.g., cancellations, rescheduling, documentation requests, billing)

  • A remote-first work culture

  • A collaborative care model and multidisciplinary team that values peer consultation, and expert-led clinical guidance

  • Expert support and access to clinical leadership and training from ADHD specialists and researchers

  • Professional growth via ongoing development opportunities, including CME/CEU support and regular team case consultations

  • And more—we’re growing and evolving, so tell us what matters most to you!

About the Role

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking licensed Child and Family Therapists to join our remote, multidisciplinary team. You’ll provide clinical services including primarily ADHD and anxiety assessments with the potential to lead parenting groups such as Parent Training in Behavior Management (BPT).

We’re committed to setting clinicians up for success with peer consultation groups and guidance from ADHD and anxiety experts. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape our care model and improve workflows that support high-quality, sustainable care. We value diverse clinical backgrounds and encourage you to grow your expertise, lead initiatives, and focus on what you do best.

What You’ll Own

  • Conduct comprehensive ADHD and anxiety assessments and intake evaluations for new patients and families

  • Provide personalized treatment recommendations, including referrals to community providers when appropriate

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, integrated care

About You

  • You’re a licensed mental health professional (LPCC, LMFT, or LCSW) with a master’s degree in a relevant field—and you're passionate about providing excellent care to kids and families.

  • You’re currently licensed in California and open to getting licensed in other states (we’ll support you with that!)

  • You have experience working in integrated care settings and enjoy using evidence-based approaches, especially for pediatric ADHD and anxiety.

  • You’re tech-savvy, a quick learner, and excited about shaping the future of behavioral health through innovative, virtual care.

Nice to Have

  • Licensed in additional states

  • Spanish proficiency (with pay differential)

We’re building a team of clinicians who are collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering exceptional care. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Co-founded by a pediatric provider, with exceptional clinical leaders including licensed mental health providers in key roles shaping every major decision

  • Clinical model built to partner closely with referring providers

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration and robust case consultation opportunities

  • A diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven community where your voice matters

  • Access to expert clinical guidance from ADHD and anxiety specialists and researchers

  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and training

What We Offer

We’re committed to taking care of the healthcare providers who care for our patients. Our benefits include:

  • Part-time compensation:

    • Clinical Hourly Rate: $62.00–$96.00 per completed clinical hour

    • Administrative Hourly Rate: $25.00 per hour for non-clinical time (documentation, meetings, admin)

  • Flexible part-time hours: 8–25 hours per week, totaling clinical and administrative time, with scheduling built around recurring group cohorts and a maximum of 8 working hours per day

  • Group operating hours are 9 am–8 pm PT, Monday–Saturday, with many groups offered during after-school and evening hours

  • A dedicated care coordination team to support with administrative tasks (e.g., cancellations, rescheduling, documentation requests, billing)

  • A remote-first work culture

  • A collaborative care model and multidisciplinary team that values peer consultation and expert-led clinical guidance

  • Expert support and access to clinical leadership and training from ADHD specialists and researchers

  • Professional growth via ongoing development opportunities, including CME/CEU support and regular team case consultations

And more—we’re growing and evolving, so tell us what matters most to you!

About the Role

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking a licensed Group Therapist to join our remote, multidisciplinary behavioral health team. In this specialized role, you will exclusively facilitate virtual, evidence-based psychoeducational groups for parents and caregivers of children with behavioral health needs, primarily ADHD and anxiety.

Our parent groups equip caregivers with practical, evidence-based strategies they can use at home to support their child and strengthen family functioning. You’ll guide families through structured curricula, create an engaging and supportive group environment, and help parents translate what they learn into meaningful change between sessions.

You do not need to be an expert in every Clarity curriculum when you join. We provide training, structured materials, and ongoing clinical support to help you develop expertise in the programs you facilitate.

This is a great fit for a clinician who loves working with parents, enjoys the energy and impact of group-based care, and is excited by the opportunity to develop deep expertise in evidence-based parent interventions.

What You’ll Own

  • Facilitate structured, virtual treatment groups for parents and caregivers, including evidence-based programs supporting families of children with ADHD and anxiety

  • Deliver Clarity’s group curricula with consistency and clinical fidelity while adapting your facilitation style to meet the needs of each cohort

  • Create a warm, engaging, and psychologically safe group environment that encourages participation, skill-building, and connection among caregivers

  • Help parents understand and apply evidence-based behavioral health strategies to challenges they are experiencing at home

  • Manage group dynamics effectively, including balancing participation, redirecting discussion, and maintaining appropriate boundaries and scope

  • Complete timely, accurate clinical documentation associated with group sessions

  • Collaborate with Clarity’s behavioral health and multidisciplinary teams when families need additional clinical support or a different level of care

  • Participate in training, consultation, and ongoing quality improvement to strengthen Clarity’s group-based care model

  • Maintain reliable availability for recurring group cohorts and provide continuity for families throughout the duration of a group program

About You

  • You’re a licensed mental health professional with either:

    • A master’s degree in a relevant behavioral health field and active licensure as an LMFT, LCSW, or LPCC; or

    • A doctoral degree in psychology (PhD or PsyD) with active licensure as a psychologist

  • You’re currently licensed in Texas and open to getting licensed in other states (we’ll support you with that!)

  • You're passionate about providing excellent care to kids and families

  • You have experience working with parents and caregivers of children and adolescents and are comfortable supporting families around behavioral, emotional, or developmental concerns

  • You have experience delivering evidence-based parent-focused interventions via telehealth

  • You have experience working with children and families impacted by ADHD, anxiety, or related behavioral health concerns.

  • You have experience facilitating groups, classes, workshops, or other structured clinical or psychoeducational programming.

  • You’re a strong facilitator who can communicate clinical concepts clearly, keep a group engaged, and navigate different personalities and levels of participation

  • You’re comfortable working from a structured, evidence-based curriculum while using your clinical judgment to respond effectively to the needs of the group

  • You value measurement, feedback, and consistency and are motivated to continuously strengthen your effectiveness as a group facilitator

  • You’re tech-savvy, a quick learner, and excited about shaping the future of behavioral health through innovative, virtual care

Nice to Have

  • Spanish proficiency (with pay differential)

  • Experience facilitating virtual therapy or psychoeducational groups

  • Licensed in additional states

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Every hour of every day, soldiers, acquisition professionals, and federal partners around the world count on systems that simply cannot go down. That is where PL ALTESS comes in. As the Agile Center of Excellence for the Program Executive Office Enterprise (PEO Enterprise), the U.S. Army Product Lead Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology Enterprise Systems and Services (PL ALTESS) runs enterprise-class data centers that host hundreds of programs, thousands of virtual servers, and millions of users worldwide, 24x7x365. Our team delivers the full spectrum of IT services: data center and Service Operations Center operations, network and systems administration, cybersecurity, cloud and application modernization, disaster recovery, and lifecycle testing across physical, virtual, and cloud architectures spanning multiple geographic locations. If you want your work to matter at mission scale, this is the place.

The opportunity: Help lead the strategy for multiple complex networks across several locations. From Cisco Nexus cores to Palo Alto firewalls and software-defined networking, you will design, secure, and optimize the backbone that supports Windows, SQL, VMware, and Oracle workloads for customers across the Army and DoW.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Help lead strategies to manage, maintain, deploy, troubleshoot, and support networks for multiple customer environments.
  • Lead the planning, execution, and implementation of new network solutions.
  • Design, document, and maintain complex networks supporting Windows Server 2019/2022, MS SQL 2019, Windows 11, VMware, Oracle Linux 8.x–9.x, and Oracle systems.
  • Configure and administer Cisco Nexus, Catalyst, ASR/ISR, and Firepower platforms, plus Palo Alto firewalls.
  • Monitor and tune network performance, harden the network, and report on security and operational status.
  • Produce utilization reports with tools such as SolarWinds, Cisco Catalyst Center/Prime, and Panorama to identify problems and corrective actions.
  • Manage the lifecycle of multi-vendor data center equipment, including firmware version control and preventive maintenance.
  • Create and maintain team technical instructions, operating procedures, and policies, and recommend and implement efficiency-boosting technologies.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIRED)

  • Minimum of 12 years w/o a degree; Minimum of 10 years with AS/AA; Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD
  • DoD 8140 qualified for DCWF 441 – Network Operations Specialist at the Intermediate proficiency level
  • Computing environment / platform certification for the technologies supported (e.g., Cisco CCNP Enterprise, Palo Alto NGFW Engineer (formerly PCNSE)); may be waived for 30 days after project start
  • Active DoW Secret security clearance
  • US Citizenship
  • Background in Computer Science or IT.
  • 3+ years designing, implementing, documenting, and maintaining complex networking solutions.
  • 3+ years configuring, updating, maintaining, administering, and migrating Palo Alto firewalls.
  • 3+ years with network management, analysis, and troubleshooting tools such as SolarWinds, Cisco Catalyst Center/Prime Infrastructure, Palo Alto Panorama, and Men and Mice.
  • 3+ years configuring, updating, maintaining, and administering Cisco Nexus (9K, 7K, 5K, 2K), Cisco Catalyst switches, Cisco ASR and ISR routers, and Cisco Firepower.
  • 3 years of experience or working knowledge of software-defined networking (SDN).
  • 3+ years creating, maintaining, and following SOPs for repeatable processes, disaster recovery, and common problem resolution.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a team-player mindset.

WHAT SETS YOU APART (DESIRED)

  • 3+ years of automation and scripting with Python, Perl, TCL, or Ansible.
  • 3+ years supporting cybersecurity patch management, STIGs, SRGs, RMF, SCA-V, and CORA.

WORKLOCATION

  • Radford, VA or Remote

Ready to keep the mission running? Apply today and join the team that keeps Army enterprise systems up 24x7x365.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re hiring a SeniorPaid Social Specialist to lead performance-driven campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and CTV. This role goes beyond execution, combining creative strategy, campaign management, and data analysis to drive results at scale.

You’ll own the full lifecycle of paid social campaigns, from building and optimizing to scaling accounts often exceeding $1M/month, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams. We’re looking for someone deeply experienced in Meta direct response advertising, with a strong track record of selling products through paid social and a sharp understanding of short-form video creative.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment where you’ll collaborate directly with leadership to grow high-performing U.S. brands. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious marketers operating at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Argentina, Brazil, Portugal, Spain, and India.

What you'll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies primarily focused on Paid Social to increase brand visibility and recognition and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Obsession with short form creative and direct response creative to convert customers — how to best sell a product, how to best construct a hook, how to best guide a client on how their advertising dollars should be spent behind winning creatives.

  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Manage between 5-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Meta Ads, TikTok Pinterest, and other social platforms like Twitter and TikTok) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $80,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, andAI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, TSR, and Hold Rate.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 7+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Social, Meta in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 5+ years minimum managing paid social advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, TSR, CTR, Hold Rate)

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

Location: South Africa or Latin America

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized Operations Associate to keep a high-value deal pipeline accurate, structured, and consistently moving forward.

This is not a traditional finance, investment banking, or sales role. You won’t be responsible for complex financial modeling, sourcing deals, or hitting sales quotas. Instead, your focus will be on execution, HubSpot CRM management, reporting, deal coordination, and consistent follow-through.

You’ll own the operational details behind long, 6–12 month deal cycles, ensuring every opportunity, follow-up, next step, meeting, and task is properly tracked and completed.

If you’re experienced with HubSpot, comfortable with Excel, and naturally make sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Deal Pipeline & HubSpot Management – 50%

  • Own and maintain the deal pipeline within HubSpot CRM
  • Track:
    • Inbound interest
    • Responses
    • Follow-ups
    • Deal stages
    • Next steps
  • Manage consistent follow-up across 6–12 month deal cycles
  • Keep CRM records accurate, complete, and current
  • Maintain clean:
    • Notes
    • Tasks
    • Deal stages
    • Follow-up dates
    • Next actions
  • Flag urgent, stalled, or unattended opportunities for leadership
  • Ensure no deal or important communication is overlooked
  • Monitor overdue tasks and outstanding actions
  • Keep leadership informed of priorities and next steps
  • Maintain reliable pipeline visibility at all times

Deal Execution & Operations Support – 50%

  • Maintain and update Excel and Google Sheets deal trackers
  • Organize raw information into clear:
    • Summaries
    • Reports
    • Graphs
    • Visuals
  • Support the preparation and organization of:
    • Pitch materials
    • Client-facing documents
    • Internal deal materials
  • Coordinate meetings, calendars, and deal-related calls
  • Track action items and ensure timely completion
  • Organize deal information so it is easily accessible to leadership
  • Provide administrative and operational support throughout deal execution

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
    • Deal tracking
    • CRM updates
    • Tasks
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline management
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Formatting
    • Templates
    • Basic data handling
    • Reporting
  • Strong written English communication skills
  • Ability to independently manage professional follow-ups
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Comfortable managing repetitive follow-ups across long deal cycles
  • Strong execution discipline and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work during U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Must be based in South Africa or Latin America

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to:
    • Finance
    • M&A
    • Investment banking
    • Deal-based environments
  • Experience supporting founders or senior executives
  • Familiarity with pitch decks and client-facing materials
  • Experience creating simple charts and data visualizations
  • Familiarity with HubSpot workflows or CRM automation
  • Experience supporting long-cycle transactions or opportunities

Tools & Technology

HubSpot | Microsoft Excel | Google Sheets | Calendar & Scheduling Tools | Internal Deal Tracking Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented
  • Follow through without needing repeated reminders
  • Are comfortable managing high-volume, repetitive follow-ups
  • Notice when deals, tasks, or communications are becoming stale
  • Enjoy maintaining clean systems and structured processes
  • Communicate professionally and clearly in writing
  • Are dependable with recurring operational work
  • Proactively flag issues instead of waiting for someone else to notice them
  • Take ownership of tasks through completion
  • Understand that small operational details can have a significant impact on long-cycle deals

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You’ll start by reviewing HubSpot for new activity, overdue tasks, outstanding follow-ups, and deals requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll send professional follow-ups, update deal stages and notes, maintain Excel and Google Sheets trackers, coordinate meetings, organize deal information, and prepare reports or materials for leadership.

You’ll also regularly review the pipeline for opportunities that have stalled and proactively ensure the appropriate next step happens.

In short: you keep the deal pipeline clean, organized, and moving so leadership never has to chase updates or wonder what happens next.

Key Metrics for Success

  • CRM data accuracy and completeness
  • Percentage of follow-ups completed on time
  • Number of overdue or missed tasks
  • Deal pipeline accuracy
  • Reporting accuracy and timeliness
  • Reduction in stale or unattended opportunities
  • Accuracy of Excel and Google Sheets trackers
  • Smooth meeting and deal coordination
  • Leadership confidence in pipeline visibility and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • No sales quotas or sourcing targets
  • No complex financial modeling
  • Clear, structured responsibilities and measurable outcomes
  • High ownership of a valuable deal pipeline
  • Direct exposure to leadership and high-value transactions
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and deal operations
  • Fully remote opportunity for candidates in South Africa and Latin America
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Deal Operations
    • CRM Operations
    • Business Operations
    • Executive Operations
    • M&A / Transaction Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re highly organized, experienced with HubSpot CRM, comfortable working in Excel and Google Sheets, and relentless about following through until every task is complete, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and become the operational engine that keeps high-value deals organized, accurately tracked, and consistently moving forward.

About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote role. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland or the United Kingdom

Canada : Hybrid if based in Ottawa. Remote for other locations in Canada

About the team

The Employee Relations Specialist, EMEA is responsible for providing expert employee relations support across the EMEA region. Acting as a trusted advisor to managers, HR Business Partners, Legal, and key stakeholders, this role manages complex employee relations matters, supports organizational change initiatives, and ensures compliance with local employment legislation and consultation requirements across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

The successful candidate will bring significant employee relations experience supporting EMEA employees and leaders, including practical knowledge of employee representative structures, Works Councils, consultation obligations, and country-specific employment requirements. 

What you will do

  • Manage complex employee relations casework across EMEA, including performance management, probation reviews and extensions, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations, and terminations. 
  • Provide coaching and guidance to managers on complex employee relations matters, employment legislation, global and local HR policies, and HR processes. 
  • Support managers in navigating sensitive employee matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally compliant outcomes. 
  • Conduct thorough, objective, and timely investigations into workplace concerns, policy violations, misconduct allegations, and employee complaints.
  • Support the establishment of and ongoing collaboration with employee representative bodies, including Works Councils. 
  • Manage consultation activities and ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and employee representative obligations. 
  • Conduct country-specific legal processes as required.
  • Guide leaders and employees through the accommodation process, ensuring equitable treatment and consistent application of policy and employment legislation.
  • Identify trends and themes across employee relations activity and escalate complex or high-risk matters as appropriate. 
  • Support organizational change initiatives, restructures, acquisitions, workforce reductions, and business transformation activities. 
  • Partner with Legal, HR Business Partners, and business leaders on complex employee relations matters. 
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of employee relations processes, documentation, manager capability, and best practices across EMEA. 

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations, Labour Relations, or a related field. 
  • Minimum 5 years of Employee Relations experience supporting multiple EMEA countries. 
  • Demonstrated experience with Works Councils, employee representative bodies, and consultation processes. 
  • Experience managing EMEA-based investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, performance management, probation management, and terminations. 
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation and employee relations practices across EMEA jurisdictions. 
  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives and restructures in EMEA. 
  • Experience partnering with Legal, HR Advisors/Business Partners, and leaders on complex employee relations matters.  
  • Ability to analyze data and trends to identify potential employee relations issues and develop proactive solutions.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels within the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with employees, managers, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced organization and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to maintain a high level of discretion, confidentiality, and integrity
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cultures.

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking to hire a Technology Program Manager.

This position will be 100% Remote.

Responsible for the successful technical, schedule, and cost performance of a major program, or multiple programs, through subordinate program/project managers, in accordance with contract requirements and company policies, procedures and guidelines. Assign staff and provide technical direction as necessary to complete task. Monitor contract, subcontract, and funding; prepare forecasts of program financial performance. Develop and deliver required contract, departmental, project and/or financial reports.

  • Identify, qualify, and track new and adjacent opportunities across DISA and the broader DoD network community (task orders, recompetes, modifications, and new vehicles)

  • Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle, including the FAR/DFARS, RFIs, RFPs, task orders, and contract modifications

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, persuasive technical and management proposal content under tight deadlines

  • Strong customer-facing communication skills and comfort presenting to government and senior leadership

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities across program and growth activities

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with NaaS/XaaS, managed services, and as-a-service delivery models
  • Experience supporting pricing data calls, BOE development, or cost volume inputs

Target Salary Range

$176,000 - $282,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

*This is a remote-global role. The hiring team is considering candidates wherever CRS is registered to work at. CRS does not sponsor visas for remote employees.

NOTE: The Pay Range referenced in this job announcement only applies to applicants who perform the job within the US and to applicants classified by CRS as International Assignees. Staff hired on local payroll would follow the respective Country pay range. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your anticipated work location during the candidate selection process.

Job Summary

The Manager I, Everyday AI & Automation leads the development and execution of Digital Workplace’s strategy, governance, and oversight for Microsoft-based everyday AI, task automation, and AI agents. The Manager establishes direction, standards, lifecycle governance, and accountability for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio solutions, coordinating with business owners responsible for implementation and ongoing maintenance.

The role combines portfolio oversight with hands-on communications, adoption, licensing, financial operations, usage reporting, and program coordination. Aligned with CRS' broader AI strategy, the Manager monitors emerging Microsoft AI capabilities and coordinates with EBS and Digital Programming on complementary AI and technology initiatives.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the roadmap for Microsoft-based everyday AI, Copilot agents, and task automation within Digital Workplace.
  • Translate CRS priorities and staff needs into a prioritized portfolio of practical AI opportunities based on value, feasibility, scalability, risk, cost, and supportability.
  • Guide business owners in assessing whether to use standard Microsoft Copilot capabilities, implement an agent or automation in Copilot Studio, or address a need through another approach.
  • Lead strategy and governance for shared Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio agents and AI-enabled task automation, setting standards, guidance, review processes, and ownership expectations in coordination with business owners responsible for delivery and maintenance and technical partners responsible for technical standards and patterns.
  • Set lifecycle standards and reviews for shared agents and automation from discovery to retirement, oversee business-owner adherence, and establish accountability for deployment readiness and ongoing management.
  • In partnership with business owners, identify repeatable tasks and workflows that could benefit from an agent or AI-enabled automation, clarify intended outcomes, and establish ownership and governance requirements for business-led implementation.
  • Recommend targeted prototypes and pilots with business owners and technical partners to assess the usability, value, and risk of emerging Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio capabilities and inform strategy and governance.
  • Lead change management, communications, learning, and adoption activities that help staff use approved everyday AI capabilities effectively and responsibly.
  • In partnership with the M365 Global Admin and Director for Digital Workplace, manage everyday AI licensing and financial operations, allocating licenses, coordinating purchases, tracking and reconciling costs, and providing forecasting inputs and operational reports.
  • Integrate CRS requirements for security, privacy, accessibility, and data protection across the everyday AI implementation lifecycle, coordinating reviews as needed.
  • Monitor product adoption, user experience, quality, cost, risk, and organizational value; collect and analyze usage and feedback data; and use findings to guide investment and continuous improvement decisions.
  • Supervise assigned staff and temporary personnel, set direction on day-to-day everyday AI program work, and reinforce business-owner accountability for solution implementation and ongoing management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Practical understanding of generative AI, AI assistants and agents, prompt design, knowledge-grounded solutions, AI-enabled workflows, responsible AI considerations, and the operational requirements needed to sustain enterprise technology products.
  • Sound product judgment to identify valuable use cases and avoid solutions that lack a clear need.
  • Highly proactive and able to work independently while balancing strategic leadership with hands-on program and operational responsibilities.
  • Ability to learn new tools and concepts independently, proactively seek answers through research and experimentation, and troubleshoot problems resourcefully while recognizing when to seek additional support.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop clear staff communications and explain complex technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal, facilitation, group process, change management, problem-solving, and judgment skills.
  • Demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams, directing temporary or matrixed contributors, and building trusted relationships with business owners and technical partners.
  • Strong systems thinking and analytical approaches to product, governance, adoption, financial, and operational challenges.
  • Very good presentation, training, and listening skills.
  • Cultural sensitivity and the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, and levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated commitment to organizational learning, responsible innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness in a customer-facing role and commitment to practical, user-centered solutions.

Required Languages:English required. Proficiency in French, Spanish, or Arabic is a plus.

Travel:Must be willing and able to travel up to 10%.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes

raw.description:
Overview

GDC IT Solutions is currently seeking an AI Solutions Developer to work remotely, with approximately 25% onsite travel required.

Position Overview:

As an AI Solutions Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications and process-automation solutions, integrating enterprise systems, and leading technical initiatives to improve business efficiency, accuracy, and overall performance.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and production support of AI-powered applications and solutions within Microsoft Azure.
  • Design, build, and deploy production-ready AI agents using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use/function calling, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Partner with executive sponsors, business subject-matter experts, and continuous improvement leadership to identify, prioritize, and implement high-impact AI and automation solutions.
  • Develop and maintain Azure infrastructure and applications using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, storage, identity, and Azure OpenAI.
  • Establish and maintain secure cloud connectivity through virtual networks, private endpoints, VPNs, and secure APIs in collaboration with the IT team.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization, logging, and monitoring to ensure reliable, scalable, and observable production deployments.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms, including Oracle ERP, Salesforce, Oracle Hyperion Financial Management (HFM), and CPQ/quoting systems.
  • Develop and secure REST APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise system integrations.
  • Design document-processing and OCR workflows for technical manuals, contracts, Excel workbooks, and scanned documents.
  • Develop process-automation solutions for purchase order processing, contract review, compliance checks, price justification, quoting, and product categorization.
  • Establish AI evaluation, observability, documentation, and development standards to monitor and continuously improve solution quality.
  • Implement security best practices for credentials, model inputs and outputs, and sensitive data in accordance with government-contract compliance requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership and direction to developers and contract resources while coordinating with IT and technology development teams.
  • Track project impact and return on investment (ROI) to measure the effectiveness of AI and automation initiatives.
  • Support business intelligence reporting and dashboard development for revenue, margins, profit and loss (P&L), and resource utilization.
  • Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development and establish secure usage practices across the team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building and supporting production software, automation, or AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience architecting, deploying, and supporting applications in Microsoft Azure, including App Service, Functions, storage, identity, and Azure OpenAI/Azure AI services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying production-ready large language model (LLM) applications, including RAG, AI agents, tool use/function calling, and orchestration.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including REST API design and integration using modern authentication protocols such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
  • Working experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies such as Docker.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude/Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, or GitHub Copilot.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • U.S. citizenship required. Candidates must provide proof of U.S. citizenship and attest that they do not hold dual citizenship due to access requirements involving Unclassified Naval Nuclear Propulsion Information (NOFORN). No security clearance is required.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience deploying and supporting applications in Azure Government Cloud environments, particularly GCC-High, FedRAMP, or IL4/IL5.
  • Experience with government-contract IT compliance and security requirements, including CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, STIG, and RMF.
  • Experience with Azure network architecture and secure connectivity, including virtual networks, VPNs, private endpoints, and secure API integrations.
  • Experience implementing infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform or Bicep and CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience developing AI agents using frameworks such as Microsoft Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen.
  • Experience with vector databases, embedding models, and RAG implementations involving large technical-document collections.
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and prompt-engineering best practices.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems such as Oracle ERP, Salesforce, HFM, and CPQ/quoting platforms.
  • Experience with EDI, order-processing automation, and Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power Automate and Power Apps.
  • Experience developing business intelligence dashboards and data models using Power BI and ERP/CRM data.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with C#/.NET is a plus.
  • Product ownership experience, including backlog management, requirements gathering, and ROI tracking.
  • Experience in manufacturing, defense, maritime, or aftermarket service environments.
  • Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous-improvement methodologies.

What We Do:

GDC is a full-service IT Staffing and Solutions company specializing in the areas of IT talent placement, application development, multilingual service desk, networking and infrastructure, business intelligence, and project management.

Why Work for GDC?

  • Cutting Edge Technology and Innovation
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Employee-Centric Environment
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Holiday and Vacation

Equal Opportunity Workplace:

GDC is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Visit our Career Centerfor the latest employment opportunities.

Location:Canada

Work model:Remote

Expected compensation: Base salary starting at $90,000 CAD per annum

Vacancy status:This posting is for an existing vacancy.

About AudienceView

AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.

We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.

Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

  • We are people first.
  • We are innovative.
  • We are results-driven.
  • We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.

Why we'd want to work with you

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.

What you'll do:

  • Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.
  • Email Marketing & Nurture:Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.
  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.
  • Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.
  • Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.
  • Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.

What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience, with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.
  • Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.
  • Marketing Automation:Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.
  • Technical Stack:Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).
  • Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.
  • Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.
  • Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • High-Intent MQLs:Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.
  • Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.
  • Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates:Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.
  • Engagement & Progression:Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.

Why work at AudienceView

  • Our work helps bring live experiences to life.From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.
  • We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  • You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale.Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.
  • We're remote-first with a live-events heart.Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.
  • Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture.The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.

How we hire — our run of show

No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

  • Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.
  • Meet More of the Team (60 minutes):Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.
  • Case Study Interview (45 minutes):Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.

How we use artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.

We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.

Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.

We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.

How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer

AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.

Ready to join the show?

If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

raw.description:
Senior UX Designer – STG

Are you a UX designer driven by curiosity and craft?

Do you love designing next-gen enterprise product experiences?

Join the Akamai STG UX team!

Akamai's Security Technology Group (STG) builds the platforms that protect a meaningful share of the internet. We're looking for a Senior UX Designer to lead end-to-end design efforts from concept to launch. You'll take genuinely complex enterprise problems and turn them into interfaces that feel obvious, considered, and good to use.

If you care about the pixel and the system, if you get energy from B2B products where the stakes and the complexity are real, and if you want your design system contributions to be used by dozens of engineers every day, this role is for you.

As a Senior UX Designer, you will:

  • Be a strategic partner who represents the user and ensures their needs and feedback drive every design decision.
  • Make complex systems simple, clear, and navigable.
  • Design intuitive, visually polished interfaces that raise the bar for the whole product, from typography, layout, and hierarchy down to states, motion, and micro-interactions.
  • Own the interaction model for the flows you design: how things respond, transition, recover from error, and behave under load and at scale.
  • Maintain and evolve our design system, including auditing components, defining patterns and usage guidance, contributing new components, and partnering with engineering to keep design and code in sync.
  • Drive adoption of the design system across teams: reviewing designs against it, resolving pattern conflicts, and knowing when a one-off should become a shared component.
  • Contribute to our team's shared knowledge of design and system best practices.

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  • 5+ years of UX design experience, with work examples or a portfolio demonstrating design for complex products.
  • Substantial experience designing B2B / enterprise software, with a real understanding of how business users, admins, and technical personas actually work: multi-user workflows, permissions and roles, dense data, long-lived tasks, and buyers who aren't the end users.
  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills : A portfolio that shows genuine craft in typography, layout, color, and hierarchy, plus up-to-date knowledge of UI trends
  • Hands-on experience maintaining design systems and component libraries in Figma, covering components, variants, tokens, documentation, versioning, and adoption, plus a solid understanding of engineering constraints.
  • Fluency in English, with the ability to communicate and defend design decisions and build product and domain knowledge with technical partners.
  • A keen eye for detail and the ability to connect content, terminology, and product logic across technical domains.
  • (Bonus) Security or infrastructure knowledge is helpful, but not required.

Build your career at Akamai

Our ability to shape digital life today relies on developing exceptional people like you. The kind that can turn impossible into possible. We're doing everything we can to make Akamai a great place to work. A place where you can learn, grow and have a meaningful impact.

With our company moving so fast, it's important that you're able to build new skills, explore new roles, and try out different opportunities. There are so many different ways to build your career at Akamai, and we want to support you as much as possible. We have all kinds of development opportunities available, from programs such as GROW and Mentoring, to internal events like the APEX Expo and tools such as LinkedIn Learning, all to help you expand your knowledge and experience here.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. We are happy to discuss flexible working options in this role, please consult with the recruiter when you apply.

Working for you

At Akamai, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Our benefit options are designed to meet your individual needs for today and in the future. We provide benefits surrounding all aspects of your life:

  • Your health
  • Your finances
  • Your family
  • Your time at work
  • Your time pursuing other endeavors

Our benefit plan options are designed to meet your individual needs and budget, both today and in the future.

Learn more

Not sure if this job is the right match for you or want to learn more about the job before you apply? Schedule a 15-minute exploratory call with the Recruiter and they would be happy to share more details.

raw.title: AI-First Software Developer - Softeon
raw.excerpt: Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.
raw.description:
Ship more of what customers need, faster, and prove every change works.

Our applications run the warehouses that get orders out the door on time. We are changing how that software gets built: AI agents and AI-assisted CI/CD help us deliver more functionality to our customers, faster, with higher quality.

We are looking for an AI-first developer: someone who treats AI agents as a team to direct, not a fancy autocomplete. You will pair deep Java engineering with hands-on experience building through agents to deliver great new functionality across our applications, and you will help set the standard for how the rest of engineering works this way. You know that speed only counts if it comes with proof, so automated testing, validation and agent-assisted review are part of how you ship every change.

What you will do

  • Deliver great product functionality. Design and build new features and enhancements across our Java applications (receiving, inventory, picking, replenishment, shipping, integrations and user experience) that customers value and rely on.
  • Build with agents every day. Use Claude Code and similar coding agents to plan, implement, refactor and test features. Break work into clear specs, give agents strong context, and know when to delegate and when to step in.
  • Author and maintain agent skills. Write and refine skills, prompts, tool definitions and MCP servers that encode Softeon's domain knowledge, such as Elastic UI form and flow authoring, WMS configuration and integration patterns.
  • Own a fully automated delivery pipeline. Build and run CI/CD where every change passes automated builds, unit and integration tests, static analysis, security scanning and AI agent code review before a human approves it.
  • Make quality provable. Build and extend automated validation (unit, API and Playwright end-to-end tests) so that AI-generated code, configuration and integrations are verified automatically, with evidence.
  • Operate what you ship. Build the telemetry, logging and monitoring your features need, and treat performance and reliability as product requirements rather than a late pass.
  • Modernize with confidence. Use agents to understand, refactor and modernize existing code, add missing test coverage, and pay down technical debt without slowing feature delivery.
  • Measure velocity and quality. Track cycle time, defect rates and escaped bugs, and use the data to keep improving how agents and pipelines are used.
  • Work with product and customers. Turn real warehouse and supply chain needs into well-specified, testable software, and talk with product managers, customers and Ops teams in their language.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Share patterns, review others' agent workflows, measure what works, and help colleagues become effective AI-first developers.

Why it is interesting

  • Agents can write code faster than any team can review it. The hard part is no longer typing; it is deciding what to build, giving agents the right context, and proving that what comes back is correct in a domain where a plausible answer can still stop a warehouse. That means designing the specs, skills, tests and pipeline gates that let a small team ship enterprise software at a pace that used to need a much larger one, and there is no settled playbook to copy.
  • You will do this on mature, mission-critical applications with real customers, real data and real operational stakes, which is a harder and more rewarding problem than a greenfield demo.

Frameworks and tools you will work with:

Languages & core

  • Java 17+, Spring / Spring Boot, REST and messaging APIs, SQL and relational databases

Front end

  • TypeScript, Angular, and Elastic UI, our metadata-driven UI platform (XSLT forms and flows rendered as JSON schema)

Scripting & extension

  • Groovy scripts and connectors, extension APIs and scaffolding for customer and partner modifications

AI & agents

  • Claude Code and other coding agents, agent skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, LLM APIs, evaluation of agent output

Quality

  • JUnit, API and integration testing, Playwright end-to-end tests, test data and fixtures, mutation testing

Delivery & DevSecOps

  • GitHub and GitHub Actions (or Jenkins / Azure DevOps), automated agent code review, static analysis, security scanning, SBOM, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code

Operations

  • Logging, telemetry, monitoring and observability tooling across cloud environments

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on AI and agent-based development: building production software with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agents or similar, and/or building LLM-powered features and agents (tool use, retrieval, MCP, evaluation).
  • Expert-level Java: modern Java (17+), Spring/Spring Boot, REST APIs, multithreading, performance tuning and clean, maintainable design.
  • 5+ years of professional software development, with a track record of building, shipping and operating production systems.
  • Strong experience in supply chain, automation, MRP or ERP systems. You understand how orders, inventory, materials and fulfillment flow through enterprise systems, and you can spot an answer that looks plausible but is operationally wrong.
  • CI/CD and DevOps fluency: Git-based workflows, pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or similar), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code.
  • Automated testing, observability and continuous delivery as part of how you build, not a separate phase.
  • Prompt and context engineering skills: clear written specs, structured prompts and the judgment to evaluate and correct agent output.
  • Comfortable across the boundary: you can write the front-end, service and database code a feature needs end to end.
  • Solid fundamentals in relational databases and SQL, system design, and secure coding practices.
  • Permanent resident of the United States, legally authorized to work in the US without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.
