raw.title: Senior Systems Architect
raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Senior Systems Architect to lead the architecture, integration, implementation, and sustainment of mission-critical Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) enterprise systems operating within secure AWS GovCloud environments.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint Corporation is seeking a Senior Systems Architect to lead the architecture, integration, implementation, and sustainment of mission-critical Department of Defense (DoD)/Department of War (DoW) enterprise systems operating within secure AWS GovCloud environments. The Senior Systems Architect will serve as the technical authority responsible for defining system architecture, infrastructure strategy, cloud engineering standards, and integration approaches supporting highly sensitive data and operational workloads within Impact Level 4 (IL4) and Impact Level 5 (IL5) environments. This role provides technical leadership across platform operations, infrastructure modernization, DevSecOps, configuration management, and release management activities while ensuring compliance with DoD cybersecurity and interoperability standards. The successful candidate will work directly with government customers, senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and program leadership to translate mission requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical solutions supporting critical defense operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect who combines DoD mission experience, AWS GovCloud expertise, enterprise architecture knowledge (DoDAF/TOGAF), and strong customer-facing leadership skills. This individual can effectively bridge strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations while leading the evolution of secure, mission-critical defense systems.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and sustainment of enterprise applications and infrastructure solutions hosted within AWS GovCloud IL4/IL5 environments.
  • Develop and maintain logical, physical, application, data, and security architectures aligned with DoD requirements and enterprise architecture frameworks.
  • Provide technical leadership for cloud engineering, platform operations, infrastructure modernization, configuration management, and release management activities.
  • Establish architecture standards, technology roadmaps, and engineering best practices supporting secure, scalable, and resilient operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, and stakeholder engagements with government customers and executive leadership.
  • Develop and maintain architecture artifacts, system diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans.
  • Ensure compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements, Zero Trust principles, and cloud security standards.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks related to architecture, performance, security, data management, and system integration.
  • Mentor technical staff and provide leadership across multidisciplinary engineering and operations teams.
  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts, recommendations, and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

Clearance
  • Active Secret security clearance required.
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in systems architecture, enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or systems engineering supporting federal or DoD environments.
  • Experience architecting and implementing enterprise systems within AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Proven success leading enterprise modernization, systems integration, and cloud transformation initiatives.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical operational systems handling sensitive or regulated data.
  • Demonstrated leadership of technical teams and coordination with government customers and stakeholders.
Technical Knowledge
  • Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks, including DoDAF, TOGAF, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Experience designing and implementing AWS cloud-based architectures, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation practices.
  • Deep knowledge of DoD cybersecurity, interoperability, and data standards, including:
    • NIST SP 800-53
    • Risk Management Framework (RMF)
    • Zero Trust Architecture
    • DoD Cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG)
  • Experience designing, integrating, and sustaining systems supporting mission-critical defense operations.
  • Knowledge of system integration patterns, APIs, networking, identity management, and cloud security architectures.
Preferred Certifications:One or more of the following certifications is highly desirable:
  • TOGAF 9/10 Certified
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)
  • AWS Security Specialty
  • DoD 8570/8140 Certification (Security+ CE, CISSP, or CISM)
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
Skills
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Proven technical leadership and team collaboration skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex architectural concepts to executive, operational, and technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to balance mission requirements, cybersecurity compliance, operational sustainment, and technology modernization.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

About Kami

Kami is a thriving organisation filled to the brim with talented, creative, and passionate people! It’s hard not to love what you do when our leading digital classroom platform offers meaningful solutions to over 70 million users worldwide, empowering students and supporting teachers!

You’ll be joining at a pretty magical time. Kami’s user base is growing by the day. With over 170 team members across the world, we couldn’t be prouder of the accomplishments and milestones we’ve achieved to date. Now, this is your chance to join our team and become an integral member of Kami’s growth, while shaping your own future (and having fun doing it)!

The Opportunity

The Sales Development Representative plays a key role in building relationships and creating opportunities for our world-leading education creativity app. This role is responsible for supporting the sales team by generating and qualifying leads, crafting effective outreach campaigns, and helping grow our business with schools and districts around the world. The ideal candidate is a creative, organized, and confident communicator with a passion for education and a drive to create a positive impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with customer success and sales teams, particularly in the US market, to assist with opportunities and ensure a smooth handoff.
  • Use a CRM to track all communications, monitor progress, and report on goals.
  • Confidently make calls and talk to prospects, building relationships and moving opportunities forward.
  • Close and process smaller opportunities as they arise, taking full ownership from start to finish.
  • Research and identify potential customers and craft beautifully written emails and outreach strategies to engage them.
  • Qualify incoming inquiries and escalate leads to Account Executives as appropriate to support the sales pipeline.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 1+ years in sales development experience
  • Proven track record of achieving objectives in a sales or customer-focused role, or a recent graduate with relevant experience
  • Experience with digital tools and apps; knowledge of the education sector is an advantage
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with an understanding of how to build relationships
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks
  • Passionate about education and helping educators access transformative digital tools
  • Proactive and a strong sense of ownership and initiative
  • Confident and comfortable with prospecting and making calls
  • Collaborative and a true team player with strong interpersonal skills
  • A natural problem-solver with strong decision-making skills

Why Kami?

We’re building a high performance, best in class team to help capitalize on our exciting momentum, and continue scaling Kami's magic and making a difference to schools, students, and teachers. With Kami, you’ll have

    • A people-first employer that is on an inspiring mission to build the future of education while changing the lives of millions
    • High calibre and diverse team ranging from successful startup veterans, to Fortune 500 and big tech professionals

ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. As an Alaska Native owned corporation, our work helps secure an enduring future for our shareholders. Join our team and discover why we are a top veteran employer and Certified Great Place to Work™

ASRC Federal is seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer with strong experience in ETL development and relational database performance for a remote, full-time position

This role will design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and the database backend supporting our applications. Primary responsibilities include implementing data ingestion and transformation workflows, developing ORM-based data access using Java persistence frameworks, and optimizing SQL and database operations.

The ideal candidate is passionate about building robust, scalable systems. They bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can troubleshoot performance across Java application code, ORM-generated queries, and relational databases. Backend services and API development will support data integration, processing, and retrieval.

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Java-based ETL workflows that extract, transform, validate, and load data from databases, APIs, files, and other source systems.

Implement data cleansing, transformation, deduplication, and reconciliation to ensure accurate and consistent downstream data.

Develop incremental loading, batching, retry, and recovery processes that support reliable execution and safe reprocessing without duplicate records

Build and maintain ORM-based data access layers using Java persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate, including entity mappings, relationships, and transaction management.

Develop and optimize SQL queries supporting application functionality and data processing.

Inspect SQL generated by JPA/Hibernate in Spring applications and analyze database execution plans to identify inefficient joins, excessive database calls, unnecessary data retrieval, and other performance bottlenecks.

Improve database performance through appropriate indexing, query restructuring, batching, pagination, and relationship-loading strategies.

Design and maintain relational schemas, constraints, indexes, and versioned database migrations.

Select ORM operations, parameterized SQL, or database-native bulk operations according to workload, maintainability, and performance requirements.

Implement and optimize OpenSearch or Elasticsearch queries, filters, and aggregations; troubleshoot search performance and maintain consistency between source data and search indexes. Monitor pipeline reliability, data quality, processing throughput, and query response times; troubleshoot production issues and demonstrate measurable improvements.

Create automated tests for transformation logic, database interactions, data integrity, and recovery behavior

Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to define requirements, document data mappings, and review database and pipeline designs.

Design, develop, and maintain GraphQL APIs and resolvers to support efficient data retrieval and integration with backend services and relational databases.

Develop and optimize database integrations using Amazon Aurora within Amazon RDS in AWS, including connection management, schema migrations, ETL workflows, and query performance tuning.

Required Technical Qualifications

Strong Java development experience building and supporting production backend applications.

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines and data integration workflows.

Hands-on experience with Java Spring ORM and persistence frameworks such as JPA/Hibernate.

Experience writing and optimizing JPQL and SQL queries, including troubleshooting ORM-generated SQL.

Strong SQL proficiency, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, and set-based processing.

Experience analyzing database execution plans and improving query performance through indexing and query changes.

Experience with relational data modeling, schema migrations, entity relationships, and transaction management.

Understanding of database isolation levels, locking, and concurrency.

Experience implementing data validation, incremental processing, error handling, and recoverable data workflows.

Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, and software deployment practices.

Ability to explain production performance improvements using measured results.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with workflow orchestration, job scheduling, change data capture, and pipeline monitoring.

Experience diagnosing ORM performance issues such as N+1 queries, inefficient relationship loading, and excessive entity loading.

Experience processing large datasets within defined delivery windows while managing database resource utilization.

Familiarity with Apache Spark for ETL and distributed data processing.

Education:

BS/BA degree (or equivalent) plus 8-10 years experience in related field.

WHO WE ARE:

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:

We’re looking for a Customer Strategy Manager to own relationships with a portfolio of mid-market clients and help them grow their businesses through data-informed strategy.

In this role, you will connect clients’ business goals with advertising performance, investigate challenges, and turn complex information into clear recommendations. You will work closely with channel strategists and internal teams to guide priorities, address underperformance, and identify growth opportunities.

We’re looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with strong client judgment: someone who asks thoughtful questions, takes ownership of problems, and can confidently guide difficult conversations. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, explaining trade-offs, and helping clients make informed decisions—even when your recommendation differs from their initial expectations.

Prior experience in advertising or e-commerce is helpful, but not required. We welcome candidates from other industries who bring strong analytical skills, client advisory experience, and a track record of solving business problems. You will develop expertise in Quartile’s platform and the advertising channels that support our clients.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a client-facing role involving advisory work, relationship management, or responsibility for business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose problems, identify performance drivers, evaluate options, and recommend practical next steps.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, and organizing and analyzing datasets.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and support recommendations with evidence.
  • Experience navigating difficult client conversations, managing disagreement, and constructively challenging assumptions while maintaining trust.
  • Sound judgment and resilience when handling competing priorities, changing circumstances, and problems that do not have an obvious answer.
  • A strong sense of ownership, including following through on commitments and coordinating with others to resolve issues.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools, business models, and advertising concepts.
  • Fluent spoken and written English, with the ability to lead client meetings and communicate complex recommendations confidently.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience advising clients on decisions that affect revenue, profitability, investment, or operational performance.
  • Experience in consulting, financial services, commercial account management, operations, or other roles combining analysis with client responsibility.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of clients or coordinating multiple complex projects.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce, retail, digital advertising, or advertising technology.
  • Exposure to advertising or analytics platforms such as Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Advertising, or Google Analytics.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment with substantial responsibility and changing priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own relationships with a portfolio of 15+ key mid-market accounts, understanding each client’s business goals, priorities, and challenges.
  • Monitor KPIs, investigate underperformance, and connect advertising results to the client’s broader business objectives.
  • Develop clear, data-backed recommendations and work with channel strategists to prioritize and implement campaign optimizations.
  • Lead regular weekly or biweekly client meetings, communicating performance, explaining recommendations, and aligning on next steps.
  • Guide challenging conversations with confidence and professionalism, address concerns, and explain trade-offs when expectations or priorities differ.
  • Prepare client reports and quarterly business reviews that connect results, opportunities, and recommended actions to business goals.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues, maintain accountability, and follow through on client commitments.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Quartile’s partnerships through additional channels, budget allocation, and testing initiatives.
  • Build expertise in Quartile’s platform, digital advertising, e-commerce, and retail through product training, roadmap sessions, and ongoing learning.
  • Share recurring client needs and data-backed improvement opportunities with Product and Technology teams.
  • Partner with the Implementation team during onboarding to understand client objectives and support a smooth transition into ongoing account management.

This is a PJ contract based out in Brazil.

About ZRG:

For 25+ years, ZRG has been helping our clients move forward in their industries and our candidates move forward in their careers. We started as a boutique retained executive search firm with a handful of talent professionals. Today, we are a global talent advisory firm, providing people solutions for our clients' most complex talent issues. Our core offerings include revolutionary, data-based, executive search focusing on senior leadership around the world. Our suite of on-demand talent offerings helps backfill open roles and address project-based work with specialized talent. Our consulting and advisory solutions focus on key issues like culture, strategic alignment, coaching, and sales optimization.

Leveraging our global platform of over 500 teammates with a tech-powered solution kit, ZRG is a leading talent advisory firm for leading-edge clients.

We are natively global in our reach with practitioners and entire divisions working around the world in the UK, Europe, the Middle East/North Africa, Australia, the Asia Pacific, and North and South America. Our team collaborates across geographic boundaries and industry verticals to bring you multiple solutions.

Role Summary

The Candidate Engagement & Client Success Specialist serves as a key point of contact across the clients, candidates, and coaches, ensuring a seamless, high-touch experience throughout career transition and coaching engagements.

This role is responsible for candidate outreach and onboarding, client support, coach coordination, reporting, technology-enabled program administration, and participant engagement. The Specialist partners closely with candidates, coaches, referral partners, and client organizations to deliver a responsive, professional, and supportive experience while ensuring operational excellence and program success. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills, attention to detail, technical aptitude, and relationship management capabilities to support a growing and evolving practice.

Key Responsibilities

Candidate & Coach Engagement

  • Conduct candidate outreach, onboarding, and intake conversations.
  • Connect participants with coaches, resources, webinars, and technology platforms.
  • Build strong relationships with candidates and coaches while monitoring engagement and follow-up activities.
  • Review, edit, and format resumes and career marketing documents, ensuring consistency, quality, and professional presentation while supporting efficient and scalable production workflows.

Client Success & Program Support

  • Support client accounts through reporting, participant updates, and responsive communication.
  • Coordinate participant launches, referral lists, and program activity.
  • Assist with workforce transition programs, group engagements, and special projects.

Technology & Administration

  • Maintain accurate candidate, coach, client, and program data across CRM systems and platforms.
  • Support participant enrollment, portal access, troubleshooting, and engagement tracking.
  • Coordinate webinars, communications, surveys, and program materials.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and participant experience.
  • Support new technology implementations, program launches, and growth initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ Years of experience in client success, customer service, recruiting, HR, coaching, career transition, or professional services support.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, CRM systems, reporting tools, and virtual collaboration platforms.
  • Technically savvy with the ability to learn new systems and troubleshoot user issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting coaching, outplacement, career transition, talent management, or learning and development programs.
  • Experience with Salesforce, participant portals, or customer success platforms.
  • Exposure to global clients, referral networks, or distributed service delivery teams.

Compensation is tailored to each individual based on their skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The rates mentioned in this posting represent only the base hourly, monthly, or annual pay and exclude potential bonuses, equity, or sales incentives, where applicable. Beyond base pay, we provide a comprehensive benefits package.

ZRG Partners is Mac preferred environment.

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Granicus is hiring a Small-Medium Government Account Executive to join our team! We are looking for a driven, customer-centric sales professional located in the Northeast with a technology sales background in local government to expand our market presence through net-new logo acquisition and revenue growth. Candidates must have a proven track record of successfully prospecting, developing pipeline, and closing new business across a large geographical region. This is a hunter-focused individual contributor role that requires a high degree of autonomy, outbound activity, territory development, and attention to detail.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition, generate qualified pipeline, and foster market expansion within the designated territory.
  • Collaborate closely with the Marketing Team to ensure a robust lead pipeline and effective lead nurturing.
  • Craft and communicate compelling value propositions to prospective clients, highlighting the unique benefits of our solutions.
  • Facilitate collaborative selling opportunities with partners, leveraging synergies to maximize sales potential.
  • Lead pursuit teams for larger-scale opportunities, orchestrating efforts for comprehensive client engagement.
  • Guide and educate prospects through the purchasing journey, providing insights and assistance as needed.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales plan aimed at surpassing predefined sales targets.
  • Gain deep insight into intricate customer requirements across operational, business, and technical domains, tailoring solutions accordingly.
  • Independently create and deliver customized presentations on Granicus, showcasing its potential to revolutionize public engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate internal resources, including sales support, marketing, and solution consultants, to deliver compelling pitches and proposals.
  • Oversee all aspects of sales activities within the assigned territory, including strategic prospecting, territory development, opportunity creation, pipeline management, revenue forecasting, and contract negotiation.
  • Proactively identify, target, and engage high-value prospects through outbound prospecting efforts including cold outreach, networking, referrals, and industry events.
  • Actively pursue and convert both self-generated and marketing-generated leads, maintaining a relentless focus on creating and advancing new opportunities.
  • Assist in formulating sales strategies in collaboration with the management team, drawing on market insights and client feedback.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all interactions, activities, and correspondence in our Salesforce CRM system.
  • Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews to Sales Management, Senior Management, and peers, providing comprehensive insights into sales performance and market trends.
  • Be prepared to travel approximately 30-40% of the time to engage with clients and prospects effectively.
  • Consistently build and maintain a healthy pipeline of net-new business opportunities sufficient to exceed quota expectations.
  • Demonstrate a hunter mentality by uncovering competitive replacement opportunities, penetrating white-space accounts, and creating demand where none previously existed.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • Proven pattern of success in software sales or highly technical consultative sales to business or government
  • Consistent record of outperforming quota in previous field sales position(s)
  • Successful record of managing a sales funnel with deals valuing between $10-$50K of annual recurring revenue
  • Strong understanding of information technology and multiple platforms, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly
  • Experience working with various levels of customer leadership teams, from Managers to Directors to C-Level Executives
  • Previous experience with government is a plus
  • Proficient with MS Office product suites · Experience using Salesforce.com is a plus, but not required
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, closing, organizational, time management, and teamwork skills
  • Self-motivated and driven to succeed; takes initiative, willing to go the extra mile
  • Ability to problem solve quickly
  • Ability to multi-task and work within a team atmosphere
  • Clear sense of integrity, work ethic, and a sincere interest in building strong relationships that are founded on trust
  • Entrepreneurial spirit

Pay Range

USD $75,000.00 - USD $85,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.

  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.

Growth & Recognition

raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help architect, build, and extend IronSled, a Platform as a Service designed to host applications in secure federal environments. You will be a senior technical contributor on a small, cross-functional product team responsible for evolving the platform and establishing the engineering practices, architecture, and technical foundation needed for its long-term success.

This is not a role focused on maintaining a backlog or implementing narrowly defined tickets. You will own complex capabilities from concept through production, make consequential technical decisions, identify and resolve architectural risks, and help guide less-experienced engineers. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with significant autonomy in an environment where the roadmap and technical approach are still being formed.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance.

About the Team

IronSled sits within LMI’s Chief Technology Office. We are a small, high-visibility team building a secure application-hosting platform for federal agencies. Our culture operates more like a product-focused startup than a traditional government contracting program. We move quickly, use focused design spikes to resolve uncertainty, and prioritize working outcomes over unnecessary process.

At the same time, we are building for users who require reliability, security, auditability, and trust. Strong engineering judgment, disciplined execution, and attention to detail are essential.

You will work closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Lead, platform engineers, and product stakeholders. Because the IronSled roadmap and architecture are continuing to evolve, you will have meaningful influence over the platform’s technical direction, engineering standards, and user experience.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact through innovation and speed. By investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI delivers commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready artificial intelligence capabilities to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI supports the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity, modernize critical capabilities, and strengthen mission outcomes.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Own complex full stack features from architecture and data design through deployment and production support.
  • Build across Angular, TypeScript/Express, PostgreSQL, and external platform integrations.
  • Make technical decisions involving APIs, identity, permissions, security, reliability, and data architecture.
  • Partner directly with product leadership to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions.
  • Establish engineering standards, review designs and code, and mentor other engineers.
  • Identify technical risks, improve platform architecture, and balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production full stack applications.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript, Angular, Node.js or Python, PostgreSQL, and RESTful API design.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex features and make sound architectural decisions.
  • Experience with authentication, authorization, secure application design, testing, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to operate effectively with incomplete requirements and limited day-to-day direction.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving team development practices.
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools in a disciplined engineering workflow.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a security clearance.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience working on a PaaS, internal developer platform, developer portal, or cloud-native product.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, containers, and event-driven integrations.
  • Experience integrating with GitLab, Okta, Entra ID, OIDC, SAML, Trivy, Fleet, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing software under federal security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • A strong portfolio, open-source contributions, or other evidence of building products outside assigned work.

Target salary range: $111,000 - $211,000

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

raw.title: Associate Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.
raw.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.

The Associate Software Engineer will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
  • Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
  • An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
  • Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
  • Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
  • Next.js or React.
  • Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
  • IT support experience.
  • Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

Responsibilities:

Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.

Build and ship

  • Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
  • Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
  • Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
  • Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
  • Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
  • Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
  • Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

AI development and enablement

  • Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
  • Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
  • Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
  • Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

Discover and plan

  • Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
  • Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
  • Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

Tools you may work with. These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.

  • App development: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
  • Cloud and hosting: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
  • Automation: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
  • Business systems: Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
  • Source control and CI: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Growth and milestones

This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.

Day 30: Learn the platform, ship a fix to a live app, and join a VITALs discovery session.

Day 60: Own one automation from end to end, with tests and a runbook.

Day 90: Take one VITALs project from intake to production, including user acceptance testing.

Month 6: Own one or more apps end to end. Hold regular check-ins with their department leads, and take part in architecture discussions.

Month 12: Act as a trusted technical partner to the department leads you support. Help design Valiant's future app architecture, lead discovery for new VITALs projects, and help set the direction of AI development.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $75,000 to $90,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

It lets media owners, especially retail and commerce media networks, hand campaign management and reporting directly to their advertisers, across onsite and offsite channels such as Meta, Google and Adform. As a Senior Fullstack Engineer on the Console team, you'll help modernize the systems behind the product, improve its reliability and robustness, and build the new features that win and grow customers. Learn more about Console: .

LOCATION: REMOTE – UK, Portugal, Spain, Germany, Hungary, or other EU countries. This is a fully remote role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

PAY TRANSPARENCY:Kevel uses external, third-party market data to determine compensation for all open positions. Our compensation philosophy is based on the candidate’s specific working location and experience level. This means that we will take a no negotiation approach in our recruitment and offer processes. We believe this is an important step in living our value of embracing diversity while underlining our commitment to fair, equitable and inclusive pay practices. An exact offer for this position will be determined based on the candidate's working location and experience level, in relation to our existing team.

All compensation packages include the additional benefits as described in the 'Why you'll love working with us' section below. We also have a transparent ‘Total Rewards Philosophy’ we’d be happy to share with you which describes our overall approach to compensation and benefits in full detail! Our recruitment team can share more about this with you in an initial phone interview and will be happy to answer any questions you have related to compensation at Kevel!

  • Work closely with the product management team to help design and build new features.
  • Help provide operational oversight for the platform, making sure we are up and running 24/7.
  • Work closely with our customer success teams to deliver value and drive growth.

SKILLS YOU'LL BRING WITH YOU:

  • MUST HAVES:
    • Experience building and operating distributed systems in a cloud environment.
    • Experience designing and developing across multiple layers of an application.
    • Experience designing or maintaining latency-sensitive systems with tight response-time requirements.
    • Proficiency with relational and non-relational databases, including transactional data models.
    • Strong programming experience in at least one production backend language, ideally Clojure, Rust, Node.js, Java, Kotlin, Scala, or another JVM language.

    • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation with clear escalation paths.
  • PREFERRED / NICE TO HAVES:

    • Knowledge of React.js/TypeScript and modern frontend development standards.
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and container orchestration.
    • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code.
    • Experience modernizing legacy systems while keeping production systems highly available.
    • Experience supporting globally distributed, multi-region services.
    • Experience working closely with product and customer-facing teams on technical product features.

    • Curiosity for emerging technologies and a commitment to continuous learning.
    • Excellent problem-solving, communication and mentoring skills.
    • Empathy and the ability to support, coach and empower colleagues to deliver their best.
    • Self-driven, with a desire to improve processes, teams and engineering practices.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING WITH US:

  • Fully Remote Team: We are a 100% remote work environment with employees located around the world. You are welcome to work from home, one of our offices, a WeWork office, or an equivalent co-working space.
  • Flexible Working Hours: We understand our employees have their own lives, responsibilities and working preferences. We trust our employees to communicate with their managers, and work when they work best.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits - Kevel provides 100% employer paid medical benefits for our employees and their children, plus comprehensive, affordable coverage for all other dependents.
  • Savings opportunity for the Future: Kevel offers retirement savings plans with employer contributions so employees can save toward future financial objectives.
  • Rest and Relaxation: Unlimited personal time off - and we mean it! We trust our employees to take the time they need, whenever they need it. We also offer Paid Holidays + a Kevel Holiday Break (from 12/24 - 1/1 every year!)

  • Free press benefits: Kevel believes all employees should have access to legitimate news sources. You’ll receive a $300 annual allowance to subscribe to the news source of your choice.
  • You’ll work with an award winning team! We’ve won numerous Best Places to Work Awards for several years and counting! We’ve also won many awards for our Innovation, Business Intelligence, and our best-in-class products (Software of the Year, Cloud Company of the Year, Best Ad Tech and API Innovator).

ABOUT KEVEL:

Kevel (previously Adzerk) offers the infrastructure APIs needed to quickly build custom ad platforms for sponsored listings, internal promotions, native ads, and more. We are committed to helping publishers drive new revenue and take back the Internet from ad tech giants like Google, Amazon, and Facebook. Kevel was founded in 2010 in Durham, North Carolina. Kevel is proud to be an inclusive workplace with one goal in common — we want to make the internet a better place.

ALL APPLICANTS ARE WELCOME, EXACTLY AS YOU ARE:

Position Overview

The Senior Technical Support Engineer, MI – I (Tier 1) provides highly visible remote technical support across our product lines for HCUS customers. This role focuses on more complex issue and is the second level support across our Synapse products. This engineer is expected be able to resolve most of the cases that are presented to them and responsible for documenting more in-depth evaluations of issues that they are unable to resolve. This engineer must be comfortable with making decisions while working on these more complex issues. This role requires a firm grasp of time management and organizational skills.

To meet the needs of our customers, working outside normal business hours and on some weekends/holidays is required. In addition to working OT to handle workload and meet required metrics/expectations.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supports our Synapse products by remotely troubleshooting and resolving issues, assessing and clearing monitor alarms, and providing our customers with timely responses.
  • Works on 3rd party hardware, software, and network related issues that are sold or supported by FUJIFILM.
  • Effectively and efficiently uses the FUJIFULM knowledge resources available to help in the troubleshooting process.
  • Collaborates with peers and other team members when working on more complex technical issues.
  • Effectively documents cases throughout the process of troubleshooting the issue.
  • Strictly follows the Technical Assistance Center (TAC) escalation process to move cases, in a timely manner, to the next level engineer when an issue cannot be resolved.
  • Engineers must have the ability and skillset to answer and facilitate incoming customer calls, effectively communicate with our customers, and document the interactions within a case.
  • Works cross-functionally with other Synapse teams/products as required and handles other duties as assigned.
  • Monitors TAC phone system wall boards to ensure that proper statuses are maintained.
  • Positive customer surveys, documentation accuracy and consistency, timely case and project completion, and finishing the assigned trainings are standard expectations for all FUJI engineers.
  • Maintains a high level of success with yearly goals provided by your manager and metrics defined on a team level.
  • Working outside of normal business hours, overtime, holidays, and participation in an on-call rotation are required to cover the needs of the business.
  • Some short notice overnight travel, based on the needs of the business, to work on customer systems.
  • Adheres to the Company's quality and regulatory compliance requirements, without exception, and ensures that all job duties inherent in the position description are performed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

Qualifications:

Baseline Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, Trade School Certification (Industry related), or Industry Experience Equivalent
  • One or more industry-specific certifications in relevant technical background (Microsoft, VMware, Cisco certifications preferred).
  • Working knowledge of Windows OS (Microsoft Server 2012, 2016, 2019, 2022+), networking, SQL Server, and/or Oracle.
  • Knowledge of current network technologies.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, excellent phone manner.
  • Ability to achieve results and meet goals in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Ability to make independent decisions based on interpretation of technology data and product knowledge.
  • Excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills.
  • Knowledge of Synapse workflows and their implementations.
  • Knowledge of clinical data transfer protocols and interfaces (HL7 and DICOM)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • FUJIFILM Synapse Administration experience.
  • Working knowledge of Synapse workflows and their implementations.
  • Working knowledge of clinical data transfer protocols and interfaces (HL7 and DICOM)
  • Knowledge with Synapse application front end.
  • Knowledge of medical informatics architecture (VMware and Storage Solutions).
  • Knowledge of Linux Architecture.
  • Experience of using Postgresql
  • Industry-specific certifications in relevant technical background (Microsoft, VMware, Cisco certifications).
  • Security Certifications (Security + or higher)

Key Performance Indicators:

  • To maintain this position engineer’s must:
    • Maintain Security+ Certification (Security + or higher)
    • Maintain and expand knowledge acquired to be designated as a TAC Subject Matter Expert (SME) in two disciplines.
  • All engineers must maintain a case workload within 10% of the median of their peers at a minimum.
  • Case backlogs must stay at or below 25 cases (not including escalated cases) unless approved by management.

Physical Requirements:

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up to 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work time.

Travel:

Occasional (up to 10%) travel may be required based on business need.

With over 20 years of experience and an annual transaction volume exceeding $150 billion, our Client is a powerhouse in digital wallets (Skrill, NETELLER), eCash solutions (clientcard), and merchant acquiring.

  • Integrate UiPath GenAI Activities, Document Understanding, and external APIs to bridge "reasoning" with "action"

  • UiPath Certified Advanced RPA Developer (UiARD) is required
  • Expert-level proficiency in UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, Action Center, and Apps
  • Strong skills in .NET (C# / VB.NET), SQL, and complex Regex for data manipulation
  • Proven experience with REST/SOAP APIs and handling complex JSON schemas for AI context windows
  • Hands-on experience with UiPath AI Center, Document Understanding, and integrating LLMs (OpenAI/Gemini)
  • Deep mastery of Robotic Enterprise Framework (ReFramework) and its customization for long-running processes

What’s in it for you?

raw.description:
Overview

The Opportunity:

Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, is adding a Senior Project Analyst and Testing Engineer to our Defense Logistics Agency team based in Philadelphia, PA.

Why Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

Amyx has been a leader in the Federal Defense, National Security, and Intelligence industry for over 25+ years. In 2023 we joined Tetra Tech, enabling us to combine our expertise with the reach and resources of a prestigious global organization.

At Amyx and Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in IT/OT, Cyber, Mission Support Service, Water, Environment, Energy, and International Development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact:

Join Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Join a mission-focused team at the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) dedicated to maintaining and modernizing critical medical logistics applications that directly support military customers. As a Senior Project Analyst and Quality Engineer, you will manage complex, state-of-the-art test programs while serving as a key bridge between stakeholders, users, and software developers. The role requires translation of complex program requirements into testable objectives, developing comprehensive test plans and procedures, and guiding the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement decomposition to release verification. You will work closely with cross-functional technical teams, apply use cases and user stories to create test cases, and independently assess system performance against stated requirements to ensure high-quality software delivery. Additional sustainment tasks, such as monitoring production environments and performing analysis on databases, may be required.

  • Designs and executes test cases and test procedures to support software release targets and meeting requirement needs.
  • Translates complex program requirements into clear, testable objectives and assists with decomposition of user stories/requirements to a level of sufficiency that software developers can implement, including insertion of best practices for ensuring user stories/requirements are testable.
  • Develops and implements the overall test strategy, including defining clear test objectives, methodologies, analysis, schedules.
  • Leads and mentors QA Testers in designing detailed, executable test plans and compensating for test limitations and restrictions.
  • Incorporates automation to test cases where appropriate to expedite test execution.
  • Fosters excellent relationships with business analysts and/or stakeholders/users to understand user story and requirement needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-team technical or business resources to coordinate the resolution of data, requirements, or testing process issues that impact application quality.
  • Provides feedback on business direction, interpretation of requirements, and updates to test cases; executes test cases and signs off for release completion when necessary.
  • Captures, tracks, and manages test plans, test cases, and test steps in the enterprise repository and program-provided tools (e.g., Azure DevOps/TFS), and manages test case signoff and overall test plan posture, providing updates to project lead on testing posture.
  • Participates in software releases and deployments with Infrastructure and Application developers, supporting project leads where appropriate to review application functionality when going live and assist with documentation needs.
  • Develops a deep functional understanding of application business capabilities and continuously learns new business and technical domains.
  • Utilizes data analysis and SQL skills to investigate issues, validate database state, and provide reports as needed by stakeholders, users, or other clients in a timely fashion.
  • Leads analysis efforts to dissect test output data, interfaces with the client, provides clear results, and recommends corrective actions. Uses these skills in development and production environments as demands require.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the project, assisting project lead to support the overall stakeholder need and mission objectives.
  • Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
  • Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline knowledge and awareness.
  • Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
  • Additional duties as required.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to achieve a NACLC security background check.
  • Minimum of 5 years related experience.
  • Experience in testing software applications, including system, regression, acceptance, end-to-end, performance, and automation testing.
  • Experience in an Agile environment, with demonstrated knowledge of System Operations, Engineering, and DevOps integration.
  • Experience developing and maintaining test cases and requirements using designated automated test tools and repositories like Azure DevOps/TFS.
  • Must have detailed familiarity with commercial test environments and operating procedures.
  • Experience translating complex program requirements into testable objectives, and decomposing requirements for development.
  • Experience analyzing and recommending test cycles, test plans, and detailed test objectives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, experience working effectively with diverse organizations and personalities, and is a “team player”.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certification from a nationally recognized technical authority (e.g., ISTQB, CSM, PMP, or equivalent).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
  • Military Medical Supply Chain experience is a big plus.
  • Possess significant experience performing complex analysis using SQL to validate application behavior or generate business reports.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating or leading the development/testing of Web-based applications (e.g., .Net MVC, Angular).

Life at Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

  • Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
  • Merit-based financial rewards.
  • Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
  • Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
  • Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Amyx and Tetra Tech:

Amyx, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Tetra Tech, and our mission is to exceed our customer's expectations on every contract, to provide an environment that encourages, recognizes and rewards the extraordinary contributions of our employees, and to advance and support the communities in which we work and live.Amyx is a management and technical solutions provider and a "trusted partner"​ to our Federal Government clients on programs of national importance. We understand that successful programs require superior performance and a level of trust achieved through genuine rapport with the customer. Award-winning results have propelled Amyx to become one of the fastest growing businesses in the Washington Region. Amyx's service offerings include: - Program Management and Acquisition Support - Systems Engineering and Implementation - Enterprise Architecture - Business Process Transformation

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Please contact with any questions!

Amyx is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Amyx is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

Physical DemandsEmployee needs to be able to sit at a workstation for extended periods; use hand(s) to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Most positions require ability to work on desktop or laptop computer for extended periods of time reading, reviewing/analyzing information, and providing recommendations, summaries and/or reports in written format. Must be able to effectively communicate with others verbally and in writing. Employee may be required to occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Regular and predictable attendance is essential.
